title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, PayPal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.
 



  





 Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.
 



  





 At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!
 



  





**The Role** 




 Our Onboarding team owns how new customers sign up to Sinch and get verified (KYC). It is the very first experience every customer has with us, so it needs to be fast, simple, and secure.
 



  





 As a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will design and deliver features end to end across our React frontend and Node.js backend. You will join a small Stockholm-based team alongside a Senior full-stack Tech Lead and a full-stack engineer, as we grow a permanent team that takes full ownership of the product. You will turn unclear requests into clear plans, make sound technical decisions, and help raise the bar for the team. You will collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Product, and cross-functional teams. This is a hybrid role, working from our Stockholm office.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Design and build features end to end, from React UI to Node.js and TypeScript services.
* Design and build REST APIs and work with SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar).
* Write tests on both backend and frontend, and keep quality high through code reviews and CI/CD.
* Turn unclear requests into clear plans.
* Make good technical decisions and explain the trade-offs.
* Suggest a simpler option when a feature is not worth the cost.
* Reduce production issues by finding root causes.
* Take ownership of the result, not only the code.
* Improve others through code reviews and mentoring.
* Follow a build-ship-run approach.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* 7+ years of software development experience.
* Experience in Node.js and TypeScript.
* Strong skills building and designing REST APIs.
* Good knowledge of SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar).
* Solid skills in React (hooks, state management, component design).
* Good knowledge of HTML, CSS, and web performance basics.
* Experience writing tests on both backend and frontend.
* Experience with Git, code reviews, and CI/CD.
* Ability to design features end to end and explain your choices.
* Ability to work independently on large and unclear tasks.
* Clear communication in English, written and spoken.
* Willingness to work hybrid from our Stockholm office.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Working experience with Java (Spring or Spring Boot).
* Experience with message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS).
* Experience with Docker and a cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools.
* Knowledge of security best practices.



  





**OUR HIRING PROCESS** 




 We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.
 



  





 We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn’t what you’re looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!
 



  





 The pay range for this role is SEK 745,000-1,110,000 per year depending on experience.

title: Utvecklare inom mobila lösningar
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla nästa generations mobilapplikationer – och samtidigt skapa verklig nytta för några av Sveriges mest spännande företag inom industri, transport och bygg? Då är CGI rätt arbetsplats för dig!
   

  

 Hos oss på CGI får du arbeta i teknikens framkant när det gäller kompetensutveckling och ny teknik – för att kunna stötta våra kunder i den digitala transformationens snabba förändringstakt.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

 Som utvecklare av mobila lösningar blir du en viktig del av ett team som designar, utvecklar och förvaltar mobilapplikationer för både iOS och Android. Du arbetar nära UX/UI-designers, backend-utvecklare och produktägare för att skapa användarvänliga, prestandaeffektiva och säkra applikationer – ofta i projekt som påverkar stora delar av våra kunders verksamheter.
   

  

 Hos oss får du:
   

  

* Arbeta med både native (Swift, SwiftUI, Java) och cross-plattform-lösningar (.NET MAUI, hybridappar).
* Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med UX/UI-designers, backend-utvecklare och produktägare.
* Hantera publicering till App Store och Google Play.
* Delta i DevOps-arbete och bidra till CI/CD-pipelines för mobila applikationer.
* Säkerställa hög kodkvalitet och en trygg användarupplevelse genom testdriven utveckling.


**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
 Vi tror att du har minst fyra års erfarenhet av mobilutveckling, men viktigast är din vilja att lära, dela kunskap och ta ansvar för helheten, från idé till slutprodukt.
   

  

 Du har även:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av minst en mobilplattform (iOS, Android eller cross-plattform).
* Kunskap om RESTful API, databaser (SQL, NoSQL), och Azure.
* Förståelse för säkerhet i mobilappar (OAuth, JWT, användardata).
* Vana vid arkitekturmönster som MVVM och Clean Architecture.
* Erfarenhet av agila metoder (Scrum, Agile).


 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen tror vi att du drivs av att skapa lösningar med hög kvalitet och stark användarupplevelse. Du har en naturlig nyfikenhet på ny teknik och ett genuint intresse för att förstå användarnas behov. Du arbetar självständigt men uppskattar det agila samarbetet med kollegor, där kunskapsdelning och gemensamt ansvar för resultatet är en självklarhet. Du tycker om att bidra till teamets utveckling, coacha andra och vara en aktiv del i tekniska beslut.
   

  

 I rollen har du möjlighet att arbeta både in-house och hos kund, beroende på projekt.
   

  

 Vill du vara med och skapa digitala lösningar som gör verklig skillnad – i en miljö där du får växa, påverka och trivas? Välkommen till CGI!
   

  

**Vill du veta mer?**
 Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande så skicka in din ansökan redan i dag! Om du har frågor om rollen, hör gärna av dig till rekryterande ledare Annika Widell, Director Consulting Services/ Konsultchef, på annika.widell@cgi.com
   

  

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
 Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
   

  

 You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
   

  

 Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
   

  

 You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
   

  

 That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
   

  

 Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: Senior/Middle Fullstack developer
description:
**About Reqtest**
 Reqtest is the leading Nordic SaaS platform for quality assurance in digitalisation projects. We're a small, focused team with high ambitions and strong commitment. Our 200 customers in Sweden and abroad include well-known brands such as Lantmännen, Scania and Philips Healthcare. We already have a product our customers love: 4.5 out of 5 on Capterra, and customers stay with us for 8 years on average. But we still see big opportunities to make it even better. Our vision is to help our customers succeed with their digitalisation by taking control, working in a structured way and collaborating successfully in their digitalisation projects.
   

  

 Reqtest is part of the Nordtech Group, which acquires and develops successful tech companies. Reqtest is entering its most important phase yet: moving development in-house and rebuilding the product around AI.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a full-stack developer at Reqtest, you build features end to end, from front end to back end. You build new functionality, including generative AI features and integrations, and improve what's already there, with a focus on quality and value for the customer.
   

  

 You're part of the dev team, report to our CPO and collaborate closely with both the CPO and our CTO. We're a small company with a flat organisation, so you're close to everyone and see the impact of what you build.
   

  

 You'll work agent-driven, where agents do much of the work and you direct, review and own the result. You follow your features all the way, from understanding the need, sometimes in meetings with customers, through technical decisions, implementation and testing, to release and follow-up. You'll also help us make the move to an AI-native way of working and shape what it looks like.
   

  

**In short, you will be working with:**
* building features end to end, front end (Angular, TypeScript) and back end (.NET/C#)
* developing generative AI features in the product
* building and maintaining integrations with other systems
* securing quality through code reviews, test automation and E2E tests in a continuous deployment setup
* making technical and architectural decisions together with the CPO and CTO
* turning needs into technical solutions, working closely with the product, operations and customer teams
* using AI tools as a natural part of the development workflow, not just as an add-on


****To succeed in this role, we believe you have****
* 5+ yeas as a full-stack developer within .NET/C#, Angular and TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience of agent-driven development, including setting up agents and basic AI infrastructure.
* Experience shipping generative AI features to production.
* Experience of test automation, from unit to E2E, and continuous deployment.
* Experience building integrations via REST APIs.
* Fluent English.


**Nice to have**
* Experience of Workato or another iPaaS.
* UX/UI skills.
* A clear product mindset and experience of SaaS environments.
* Experience of introducing new ways of working or technologies in a team.
* Experience of SQL Server, CQRS, and performance and optimisation.
* Swedish language skills.


**Your style**
 You're curious about more than the code – you want to understand the product and the customers who use it, and you're comfortable joining a customer meeting when it helps. You don't wait for a detailed spec: you take a problem, ask the right questions and find a solution. You thrive with a lot of responsibility and freedom.
   

  

 You keep up with AI because you want to, not because you have to – you try new tools and models, share what works and like to prototype before deciding. You're not afraid to have an opinion, but you listen before you decide – and you're happy to let the best idea win.
   

  

****Your time at Reqtest****
* Real influence over the product, the tech and our move to an AI-native way of working
* Short decision paths and close contact with customers
* Modern offices at Convendum, Gävlegatan 16 in Vasastan, Stockholm. We're on site about 4 days a week, because that's where the culture is built, with flexible hours
* Breakfast, gym and a good work environment


**We interview on an ongoing basis. The process:**
* Screening call with our recruitment partner
* First interview: competencies and soft skills
* Alva Labs tests
* Tech interview/case: about 2-3 hours of independent prep work, then you present your solution to us
* References and background check
* Offer


**We want to get to know you properly, and we hope you want to get to know us :)**
 Send your application today - we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Integrationsutvecklare till Unionens IT-enhet
description:
Vill du bygga robusta och säkra integrationslösningar som får verksamhetskritiska system, data och processer att fungera tillsammans? Hos Unionen får du en central roll i utvecklingen av vårt integrationslandskap, med möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, integrationsarkitektur och arbetssätt i vår fortsatta digitalisering.
   

  

 Som integrationsutvecklare ansvarar du för att designa, utveckla, testa och underhålla integrationer mellan Unionens interna och externa system. Du omsätter verksamhetsbehov till hållbara integrationsflöden och arbetar med API-baserade, händelsedrivna och meddelandebaserade lösningar. Rollen omfattar hela livscykeln – från kravanalys och lösningsdesign till driftsättning, övervakning, felsökning och kontinuerlig förbättring.
   

  

 Rollen är hands-on och har samtidigt ett tydligt ansvar för kvaliteten i integrationsområdet. Du samarbetar nära arkitekter, utvecklingsteam, produktägare, verksamhet och leverantörer för att skapa väl dokumenterade, återanvändbara och framtidssäkra lösningar. Genom gemensamma integrationsmönster, automatiserade leveranser och god spårbarhet bidrar du till stabila informationsflöden och effektiva digitala tjänster för Unionens medlemmar och medarbetare.
   

  

 Arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 Du blir en del av teamet som utvecklar och förvaltar Unionens integrationslösningar. Arbetet präglas av helhetsperspektiv, informationssäkerhet och en ambition att standardisera integrationsmönster, minska punkt-till-punkt-kopplingar och skapa lösningar som är enkla att övervaka, felsöka och vidareutveckla.
   

  

 Du arbetar i ett agilt utvecklingsteam med utvecklare, arkitekter samt test- och utvecklingsledare. Teamet består av både Unionens anställda och konsulter och arbetar nära verksamheten.
   

  

* Analysera integrationsbehov och omsätta verksamhetskrav till teknisk design, gränssnittskontrakt och dataflöden.
* Designa, utveckla och förvalta API-baserade, händelsedrivna, meddelandebaserade och schemalagda integrationer mellan interna och externa system.
* Utveckla integrationslösningar i Azure och Microsofts ekosystem, exempelvis med API Management, Service Bus, Functions, Logic Apps och .NET.
* Integrera verksamhetssystem, datakällor, molntjänster och externa tjänster med hjälp av lämpliga API:er och integrationsmönster.
* Säkerställa autentisering, behörighetsstyrning, dataskydd, felhantering, loggning och spårbarhet i integrationsflödena.
* Automatisera bygg, test och driftsättning samt bidra till versionshantering och CI/CD för integrationslösningar.
* Övervaka och felsöka integrationer, analysera rotorsaker och genomföra förbättringar som stärker tillgänglighet och prestanda.
* Dokumentera lösningar, utveckla gemensamma integrationsmönster och dela kunskap med team, arkitekter och leverantörer.


 Vem är du?
   

  

 Vi söker dig som är en erfaren integrationsutvecklare och som trivs med att ta ansvar för hela integrationskedjan. Du kombinerar god programmeringsförmåga med förståelse för integrationsarkitektur, informationsflöden och drift. Du kan växla mellan nyutveckling, förvaltning och felsökning och bidrar gärna till gemensamma standarder och tekniska vägval.
   

  

 Vi ser gärna att du har
   

  

* Flera års dokumenterad erfarenhet av integrationsutveckling i komplexa systemlandskap.
* Goda kunskaper i C# och .NET samt erfarenhet av REST-baserade API:er, JSON och autentiseringslösningar.
* Erfarenhet av integrationsmönster såsom synkrona och asynkrona flöden, meddelandeköer, händelser, batch och datatransformation.
* Erfarenhet av Azure Integration Services, exempelvis API Management, Service Bus, Functions eller Logic Apps.
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD, automatiserade tester, loggning, övervakning och felsökning av integrationslösningar.
* Förståelse för API-säkerhet, identitet, behörighet och hantering av känslig information.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.


 Du är strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och prestigelös. Du trivs i en miljö med hög förändringstakt och många kontaktytor, samarbetar väl i team och kan samtidigt arbeta självständigt för att nå områdets mål. Du tänker långsiktigt, strävar efter ständig förbättring och är trygg med att förutsättningar kan förändras.
   

  

 Omfattning
   

  

 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med månadslön och goda villkor enligt kollektivavtal. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse och provanställning kan tillämpas. Kontoret på Olof Palmes gata är vår primära arbetsplats, med möjlighet att utföra visst arbete hemifrån eller från annan plats.
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 23 oktober. Intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningstiden, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningstid löpt ut.
   

  

 I din ansökan vill vi att du inkluderar ett motivationsbrev där du berättar vad som lockar dig med rollen på Unionen.
   

  

 Unionen välkomnar olikheter i personalgrupperna och eftersträvar mångfald i alla avseenden.
   

  

 Kontakt
   

  

**Jörgen Westerberg, sektionschef**
 jorgen.westerberg@unionen.se
   

  

 08-504 15 585
   

  

**Elahe Sharifi, fackligt ombud**
 elahe.sharifi@unionen.se
   

  

 08-504 15 430
   

  

 Om Unionen
   

  

**Vill du få kraft att göra skillnad?**
 Unionen är Sveriges största fackförbund på den privata arbetsmarknaden och landets största tjänstemannaförbund. Vår vision är att skapa trygghet, framgång och glädje i arbetslivet. Vi har inflytande, ansvar och ambition för mer än bara oss själva och mod att driva frågor som påverkar hela samhället. Varje dag hjälper vi människor i det privata arbetslivet att få det bättre på arbetsplatsen. Därför har vi en erfarenhet och bredd som ingen annan – och vi behöver dig som vill göra oss ännu bättre.
   

  

 Unionen finns i allt från stora internationella koncerner till små familjeföretag, organisationer och föreningar. Vi är en medlemsstyrd organisation byggd på representativ demokrati, med omkring 700 000 medlemmar och cirka 29 000 förtroendevalda på 16 000 arbetsplatser. Läs mer på www.unionen.se.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
At AKQA (part of WPP), we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to create ideas, experiences, and stories that move people and brands forward. With an entrepreneurial and collaborative approach, we craft culturally resonant work that blends creativity, storytelling, design, technology, and innovation to create meaningful impact.
   

  

 In the heart of innovation, AKQA Sweden thrives. We are privileged to collaborate with a fantastic portfolio of clients, including Volvo Cars, Google, Volvo Penta, H&M, IKEA, and more. Each partnership is a shared pursuit of creating transformative digital products and services tailored to their distinct needs and aspirations. We are in relentless pursuit of the beyond, shaping the future with our clients, our people, and our planet at the core. Our work is not just our profession, it's our passion, and our commitment is to a future where everyone has the opportunity to shine. We are not just creating for today: we are creating the Future. Faster.
   

  

 Working in the Tech team connects you with talented experts across disciplines who are passionate about delivering work of the highest quality and creating maximum value for our clients.
   

  

 You should be an established fullstack engineer, fluent in modern headless web development end-to-end. You build best-in-class applications across the frontend, API layer, and data sources using a serverless-first, composable architecture.
   

  

 AKQA is a proud member of the MACH Alliance, and we build completely headless, modern web solutions without the overhead of legacy monoliths or self-hosted infrastructure.
   

  

**Role Requirements**
* Hands-on Delivery: Lead hands-on development on medium-to-large scale client projects.
* Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Work closely with UX, Design, Strategy, and Delivery to solve implementation challenges and turn creative visions into performant code.
* Team Mentorship: Support team members' growth by sharing knowledge, conducting code reviews, and fostering an open learning culture.
* Client Alignment: Understand client business goals to architect and implement the right technical solutions.
* Engineering Quality: Own code quality end-to-end, ensuring solutions are accessible (a11y), performant, secure, and thoroughly tested.
* Modern Ways of Working: Active practitioner of Lean & Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) with a focus on continuous delivery and improvement.
* Frontend & Frameworks: Advanced TypeScript / JavaScript (ESLatest), HTML5, Accessibility (a11y), and production-scale mastery of Next.js and React.
* Headless & Composable Web: Experience building with headless CMS platforms like Contentful, Strapi, or Sanity, and search/indexing tools like Algolia.
* Backend & Data: Building light serverless API routes in Next.js, experience with Hasura for GraphQL backends, and hosted databases like Neon Postgres or cloud (No)SQL.
* Platform & Hosting: Deployment on Vercel; familiarity integrating with client enterprise cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) when client requirements dictate.
* AI-Assisted Workflow: Comfortable using AI developer tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) and leveraging the Vercel AI SDK for building AI-driven features into web apps.
* Testing & Performance: CI/CD pipelines, automated testing (Vitest, Playwright, Cypress), performance profiling, and multi-locale internationalisation (i18n).
* Mobile app development using React Native with Expo (Expo-managed workflow) is beneficial.
* E-commerce integrations and payment gateway experience is beneficial.
* Experience with web animation tools such as Framer Motion, GSAP, and CSS animations is beneficial.


 We look for self-starting technologists who adapt quickly across a modern web landscape. The technologies above outline our most commonly used technologies at AKQA Sweden; if you have experience with comparable alternatives, that is not a blocker to success.
   

  

 QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS
   

  

* 5+ years of industry experience in fullstack web development.
* Analytical, positive mindset with a personable and professional communication style.
* Comfortable translating complex technical topics for non-technical team members and clients.
* Passion for high-detail execution, performance optimization, and new technology.
* A collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively across UX, Design, Strategy, Delivery, and Technology.
* A commitment to sharing knowledge, supporting team members' growth, and fostering an open learning culture.
* A strong understanding of client business goals and the ability to align technical solutions to those needs.
* A focus on accessible, performant, secure, well-tested, high-quality engineering.
* Comfortable working in a Lean and Agile environment, including Scrum and Kanban, with a focus on continuous delivery and improvement.


 Explore our extensive range of benefits here
   

  

 We believe great work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach including required in-office days. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

 AKQA is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
**Introducing evroc**
 At evroc, we are building a secure, sovereign, and sustainable hyperscale cloud to reimagine the digital future of Europe. By joining our company, you have an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of next-generation cloud services. We are seeking intellectually curious and highly motivated team members who are ready to embrace the thrilling challenge of building the first European-owned hyperscale cloud.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Stockholm
   

  

**Job type:** 
 Permanent position
   

  

**Join the Pioneers**
 As a Frontend Engineer on the Think team, you will shape the user experience of roc, enterprise AI you can trust with your data. roc delivers sovereign AI to European organizations that demand the highest levels of security and compliance, running on our own cloud and inference platform.
   

  

 You will help take roc beyond the chat window: building interactive artifacts alongside conversations, an embeddable assistant that organizations can integrate into their own sites, and experiences that bring roc into the tools people already use, from internal systems and knowledge bases to team chat.
   

  

 Along the way, you will influence our application architecture and engineering culture, building AI products where usability, trust, and transparency are part of the design from the start.
   

  

**What You'll Tackle**
* Design and build responsive, intuitive interfaces for enterprise AI chat, retrieval, and tool use.
* Build user experiences for streaming responses, background tool execution, and real-time state changes.
* Develop new ways for users to interact with roc beyond the traditional chat interface.
* Work closely with backend and platform engineers to ensure seamless integration across the product.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering practices that improve quality and maintainability.
* Build reliable frontend systems using testing frameworks such as Playwright and Vitest.
* Explore and apply new technologies, frameworks, and tools that improve both development workflows and user experience.


**Skills We Value**
* Typically 5+ years of professional experience in frontend development.
* Strong experience with modern JavaScript frameworks; familiarity with Svelte or SvelteKit is valued but not required.
* Strong knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frontend development practices.
* Experience building interfaces for LLM-based products, including streaming responses, markdown rendering, and conversational UX, is a plus.
* Experience with testing frameworks such as Playwright, Vitest, or similar.
* Proficiency with Git and modern collaborative development workflows.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to both functionality and user experience.
* Ability to work closely with engineers, designers, and other stakeholders in a collaborative environment.


**Why Join evroc?**
 We offer a competitive salary and an equity package to attract the best talent. Come join us to help build the next generation cloud!
   

  

 At evroc, diversity is our strength. We champion an inclusive environment where every background - ethnicity, age, gender identity, beliefs, and culture - is celebrated.
   

  

 Applicants must possess a valid work permit.

title: React Native Developer
description:
At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a React Native Developer for the next phase of growth.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will own the mobile product experience end-to-end, making real decisions about how a shared codebase should be structured, not just building features inside one. You’ll be working cross-functionally across mobile, web, and design, and your mission is to build robust features that power our rapid global expansion.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain high-performance, cross-platform (iOS, Android, web) features in our unified codebase for cross-market deployment.
* Ensure code quality through continuous testing, code reviews, and robust software architecture practices.
* Drive the implementation of AI frameworks and automated agents to shift our platform toward an agentic-first operating model.
* Optimize app performance and maintain strict security standards across high-volume financial systems.
* Use tools to monitor stability and product usage, and act on what they surface.
* Translate customer needs and UX designs into seamless, scalable frontend components.


 What we’re looking for
   

  

 You bring a structured, quality-driven approach to mobile architecture and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You take full accountability for your code, enjoy collaborating within cross-functional teams, and actively look for ways to optimize delivery through modern technology.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Several years of experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-level React Native applications, ideally including Expo.
* Proven background taking architectural ownership of mobile application frameworks.
* Strong TypeScript fluency; comfort with Redux Toolkit/RTK Query or an equivalent state-management approach.
* Hands-on experience with automated testing (unit/integration + E2E) and a disciplined code review practice.
* Professional fluency in English with strong cross-functional communication skills.


**Why Qred?**
 This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!
   

  

 One Last Thing
   

  

 This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
   

  

*Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.*
 Qred is an international FinTech scale-up that specializes in digital financing solutions for small businesses, with operations in the Nordics, Benelux, Germany and Brazil. We are passionate about helping small businesses thrive and grow, by providing them with business loans and credit cards. Right now we’re in an exciting phase of our journey that focuses on growth through smart product development and technology fueled by international expansion.

title: Game Engine Tools Developer | Shared Tech
description:
**Craft:**
 Technology & Development
   

  

**Job Description:**
 King operates mobile games at a massive scale. With titles like Candy Crush, Candy Crush Soda Saga and Farm Heroes Saga, our code runs on hundreds of millions of devices across the world. We believe that the right tools in the right hands are key to our success as a company.
   

  

 If you want to boost productivity for the teams creating entertainment for millions of players to enjoy on the go then this is the right job for you. As a
 **Game Engine Tools Developer,** 
 you will drive innovation and take a lead in creating and maintaining tools and pipelines for our mobile casual games.
   

  

 This role belongs to part of the Kingdom we call Shared Tech. The teams within Shared Tech work as B2B organizations working across all the technology that we use to power our live games, including data infrastructure, machine learning, payments infrastructure and the game engines themselves. The vision within Shared Tech is "We are the stage where King games love to perform”.
   

  

 You will be working in Shared Tech’s Game Production organization, where we focus on game-changing tooling and infrastructure to enable our content creators to build features faster, easier and more reliably. This includes working across multiple teams to facilitate both architectural decisions and hands-on development to support smaller feature teams based on rolling needs.
   

  

 You should have a broad range of knowledge and be able to context switch easily to provide active support across the whole team and beyond. The ability to see the project as a whole is crucial as you monitor the development in real- time to determine how we should support and assist the rest of the development team. You’ll also play a key role in improving our feedback loop, making it easier for teams to adopt tools and for our team to learn what’s working (or not). Strong communication and empathy for end users are essential.
   

  

 King is a place where we build features in the open, collaboratively. We value diverse opinions and make sure every voice is heard. We offer you the freedom and opportunity to work on fulfilling tasks and to continue your journey as an expert tools developer. Your Role Within Our Kingdom You will enjoy a creative, challenging and collaborative environment where your ideas will be every bit as valued as your programming expertise.
   

  

 Your role within the Kingdom
   

  

 Some of your responsibilities include:
   

  

* Improve, innovate and maintain current tooling infrastructure and in-house editing toolset
* Design, architect, maintain, test and implement tools at scale
* Collaborate with various current and future users of our tools, bridging various crafts within King with the intent to optimize, improve and discover workflows across games
* Deliver high quality and well-structured code
* Improve quality and performance inside our tools landscape
* Share knowledge and best practices with peers and game teams
* Drive and support tool adoption with stakeholders in the game teams across King
* Coach and mentor more junior developers, helping them grow in technical areas such as architecture, development patterns or testing.


**Skills To Create Thrills**
 You are a programmer who enjoys an array of challenges, and strives to deliver great products and technology. You are a self-starter, curious and a fast learner. You are excited to contribute to live games with a massive user base. You question the status quo and strive for effective innovations as much as you like maintaining and extending existing software. You enjoy being in contact with users of your tools and use their feedback to improve your work.
   

  

* Excellent Python knowledge with experience implementing high-quality standalone and web applications, paired with strong C++ experience.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Highly experienced with testing, automation and continuous integration
* Experienced with tools development and strong desire to work with tools
* Experience with performance-critical software is a bonus
* Ability to work closely with cross-discipline teams to understand their needs
* High sense of code quality and polish and the desire to build and maintain a high-quality code base
* Ability to develop on multiple platforms: Windows and OSX
* Frontend skills (JS/TS, experience with web frontend frameworks)


**Bonus Points**
* Experience with Cloud frameworks / technologies (GCP, Docker, k8s etc)
* Experience with game editor extension systems (e.g., Unity Editor scripting, Unreal Editor tooling, or custom C++/Qt editor frameworks)
* Familiarity with using observability tools, for example Sentry or Grafana
* Experience facilitating workshops or leading technical presentations internally


**What We Offer**
 In Shared Tech, our team is focused on supporting multiple game teams with high quality tools. We take pride in the tools that we deliver, and the team that builds them. We are looking for a new voice in this context and want to find someone who has the technical skills we need while also contributing to the team as a whole. We have prioritized trust and open communication as the cornerstone of our team culture.
   

  

 Finding the right mix of autonomy and support is another important aspect of work in this team. We enable this by making sure that information is shared effectively and prioritizing supporting each other when help is needed. We have chosen this approach since we believe in creating an environment that enables us to actively contribute to shaping the way we move forward. While also making sure that we, as a group, are aligned. This requires a sense of responsibility from us all, something which we are also proud of.
   

  

 We believe that in order to remain competitive we need to grow in our roles, we support this by investing time and effort into personal development continuously throughout the year.
   

  

 We also offer truly awesome benefits here at King in addition to a thriving social calendar of events for Kingsters to really get to know each other.
   

  

**A Great Saga Needs All Sorts of Heroes**
 Making games is fun. Especially when you do it with people who share the same idea of what makes a good workplace great. We design games for everyone, no matter where they are or who they are, and we employ all sorts of people from all kinds of backgrounds to bring them to life. Truth is, we simply cannot expect diversity in our players and originality in our games without first nurturing it in our people. A great saga needs all sorts of heroes.
   

  

**Making the World Playful**
 Making the World Playful is what inspires us to create new experiences and raise the bar. It’s what makes King a place where we can all dream bigger, continue to add innovation to our games, broadening the portfolio and exploring new territories in mid- core and casual. We take the art and science of gaming to the next level through our curiosity for the unexplored, passion for games, respect for each other and love for our players – and we’re not afraid to have fun along the way. In fact, together with our parent company Activision Blizzard and experts around the world, we believe having fun is good for you. There has never been a better time to join us. We're dreaming bigger and see a world of possibilities ahead. If you share our passion, our values, and our hunger to shape the future, join us in Making the World Playful!
   

  

 Applications need to be in English.
   

  

 Discover King at careers.king.com
   

  

**About King**
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Integrationsutvecklare
description:
*Är du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär och bygga framtidens integrationslösningar? Accelerate växer och vi söker integrationsutvecklare som vill vara med och skapa smarta, hållbara och effektiva IT-lösningar för våra kunder.*
**Om rollen**
 Som integrationsutvecklare hos oss blir du en del av ett starkt konsultteam som arbetar nära marknadsledande kunder. Du utvecklar robusta och långsiktiga integrationslösningar baserade på Microsoft-teknologi, både on-prem och i molnet.
   

  

 Du får arbeta i uppdrag som spänner från nyutveckling till modernisering och optimering av befintliga system. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med arkitekter, projektledare och andra specialister, där du får möjlighet att kombinera tekniskt hantverk med affärsförståelse.
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker dig som har några års erfarenhet av integrationsutveckling och som trivs i en konsultroll. Du har god vana av att arbeta i agila team och du är lösningsorienterad, nyfiken och tycker om att dela kunskap.
   

  

**Vi Ser Att Du Har Erfarenhet Av**
* Azure Integration Services: Logic Apps, Service Bus, Functions, API Management
* C#, .NET Core, .NET Framework
* REST-APIer, XML, JSON
* Databaser som SQL Server och Azure SQL
* Verktyg som Visual Studio/VS Code, Git, Postman och Azure DevOps


 Meriterande är om du arbetat med andra integrationsplattformar som BizTalk eller MuleSoft.
   

  

 Du uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift. För denna position krävs svenskt medborgarskap, vi utför även bakgrundskontroll av slutkandidat.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder dig**
 Som en del av Accelerate får du inte bara spännande uppdrag, du får också en plattform för att växa. Vi satsar på utbildning, certifieringar och kontinuerligt lärande. Du blir en del av ett nätverk av erfarna konsulter som brinner för att ligga i teknikens framkant och som gärna delar med sig av kunskap.
   

  

**Hos Oss Får Du**
* Kollektivavtal, friskvårdsbidrag och hälsoförsäkring
* Flexibilitet, frihet och balans mellan jobb och fritid
* En skräddarsydd utvecklings- och certifieringsplan
* En trygg och säker anställning med bra förmåner.
* Utmanande och varierande uppdrag med de senaste teknikerna


**Placeringsort**
 Accelerate finns på flertal orter i Sverige & Norge. För denna roll ser vi att du utgår från vårt kontor i Stockholm, med möjlighet till hybridarbete.
   

  

 Önskad start är snarast eller enligt överenskommelse. Du är välkommen att kontakta Jesper Carlsson på jesper.carlsson@iver.se vid frågor eller funderingar kring tjänsten. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
   

  

**Välkommen till Accelerate!**

title: Junior Platform Engineer
description:
Turn curiosity into practical cloud solutions as a Junior Platform Engineer in our Cloud center of excellence. You join an experienced team where you develop cloud platform features, build automation and grow your skills through close collaboration.
   

  

**About Your Job**
 You contribute to the development and maintenance of our cloud platform, with a focus on automation and landing zones. Working from the product backlog, you start with well-defined assignments and collaborate closely with senior colleagues as you build knowledge and take on new challenges.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

* Develop features and other products based on the product backlog.
* Build functionality that supports cloud platform automation and landing zones.
* Solve technical issues that arise in the platform environment.
* Collaborate with colleagues in your own team and across the other teams to deliver value to the business.
* Contribute to continuous improvements in solutions and ways of working.
* Share knowledge and experience as part of the team.


 Location
   

  

 The location is based on-site at the World Trade Center in Stockholm.
   

  

**Your profile**
 You have a university or vocational higher education background and some practical exposure to software development, whether through studies, an internship or early professional experience. A foundation in cloud or related technologies helps you get started, while your willingness to learn is central to your success.
   

  

 Your background includes
   

  

* Experience in software development, preferably C#, and an interest in backend development.

title: Design Engineer
description:
Validio is the agentic data management platform that automates data quality, lineage, and cataloging — so enterprises can finally trust the data behind their analytics, AI, and reporting. As a Design Engineer on our frontend team, you shape our core user experience — working closely with our Lead Frontend Engineer and Head of Product.
 



  





 We don't have a separate design team; the product's experience is designed by the people who build it. AI tools now handle much of the repetitive boilerplate, so the job has shifted to what we should build and how it should behave. Because generating code is easy, the bar for good architecture, code quality, and maintainability is higher than ever — we don't blindly ship AI output. Your role centers on product judgment, engineering discipline, and translating complex user needs into an interface that feels fast and lightweight.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Evolve our high-scale lineage graph — often tens of thousands of nodes per customer — so rendering, querying, and exploration stay fast and responsive
* Own the data quality experience: the density, layouts, and metric graphs that keep thousands of concurrent checks against completeness, validity, timeliness, accuracy, consistency, and uniqueness clean and quick to scan
* Turn incident response — deciding if an anomaly is real, finding the cause, checking sample rows, re-running validators, tracing lineage upstream — into one coherent workflow
* Make alerting configuration simple enough to hold in your head across Slack, Teams, Jira, email, ServiceNow, and webhooks, so the alerts that matter don't get buried in noise



  





**What you'll bring** 



* Strong product sense — you notice typography, spacing, hierarchy, and motion, and care about how a product feels to use
* A preference for the web platform — strong TypeScript and DOM fundamentals, and a clear-eyed view of framework trade-offs
* Strong SQL — performant queries against large datasets, reading execution plans, and reasoning about query cost
* Critical use of AI tools — you move fast with modern LLMs but retain full ownership of the architecture and catch what they get wrong
* A generalist mindset — comfortable across the UI, the GraphQL API, and the data layers underneath to ship a feature end to end



  





**What we don't look for** 



* Years of experience as a metric — we measure seniority by shipped work, architectural judgment, and product taste
* Strict specialization — we're looking for builders who want to own features from idea to production, not people who only want to write CSS or only design backend schemas



  





**Our stack, and why** 




 TypeScript and native Web Components on the frontend — no React, no Vue. We stay close to the web platform to avoid framework churn and major migration cycles. Node.js and GraphQL on the backend, on Postgres with the TimescaleDB extension for time-series workloads — we keep tight control over our data shapes to eliminate unnecessary latency. Claude Code is in daily use, and we adapt our engineering loop as the tooling evolves; we aim for one production release per sprint, weekly or bi-weekly. Prior experience with Web Components isn't required — solid TypeScript and DOM fundamentals are what matter.
 



  





**Why Validio** 




 Founded in Sweden in 2019, we're trusted by data-driven enterprises like Nordea, Canva, Truecaller, Traveloka, and Deutsche Glasfaser. We raised a $30M Series A this year and grew ARR 800% in twelve months as enterprises got serious about making their data AI-ready. At around 25 people, you'll decide what the core experience should be, not just how it gets built.
 



  





 Come as you are. We hire for what you'll build with us, and we welcome applicants of every background.

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
Lyten is leading an industrial revolution through Lyten 3D Graphene™, a breakthrough supermaterial unlocking a new generation of products — from lithium–sulfur batteries and energy storage systems to concrete admixtures, lightweight composites, and next-generation sensors that are revolutionizing industries. Together, these innovations are making a massive global improvement and driving real-world impact across energy, mobility, construction, and defense.
   

  

 At Lyten, we believe the most meaningful careers begin with purpose — and with people who want to make a difference. We’re not just developing advanced supermaterials — we’re about to change the world as we know it, reshaping how energy is stored, how products are built, and how progress is made.
   

  

 We’re entering an exciting growth phase, scaling production across the U.S. and Europe and expanding our team of engineers, scientists, and innovators.
   

  

 Apply now to join our team and be part of something bigger than yourself — where collaboration, creativity, and purpose come together to build the technologies that will define the next century.
   

  

 The Staff Data Engineer role will serve as a key technical leader and subject matter expert in data engineering, responsible for leading the design, development, and maintenance of advanced data solutions. The primary objective will be to architect and implement high-quality data infrastructure, driving innovation and setting the standard for best practices in data engineering within the organization. In this role, you will mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers, provide technical guidance, and collaborate closely with senior leadership to shape the strategic direction of the data engineering function. You will leverage your extensive experience and expertise to solve complex technical challenges, optimize data processing pipelines, and ensure the scalability, reliability, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness of data systems. Furthermore, you will play a pivotal role in evaluating emerging technologies, defining technical standards, and championing a culture of continuous improvement and excellence across the data engineering team. The Staff Data Engineer will work with cloud computing platforms, specifically AWS, to enable accelerated learning from data at scale.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

*Overall areas of responsibilities and activities*
 Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)
   

  

* Lead the design, development, and implementation of advanced data solutions and architectures, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Serve as a technical mentor and coach for junior and mid-level data engineers, providing guidance on best practices, coding standards, and architectural design.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and efficient data engineering solutions.

* Architect and optimize data pipelines and E(T)LT processes to improve data quality, accuracy, and timeliness.
* Define and enforce technical standards, coding conventions, and documentation practices to ensure consistency and maintainability across data engineering projects.
* Lead troubleshooting efforts and resolution of complex data-related issues, including performance tuning, data discrepancies, and system failures.
* Collaborate with data architects and other stakeholders to define and implement data governance policies and procedures.
* Participate in strategic planning and decision-making processes, influencing the direction of data engineering initiatives and investments.
* Drive a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the data engineering team, fostering collaboration, innovation, and professional development.
* Leverage AWS cloud computing to design and process large datasets.

 At Lyten, you’ll be part of a team that’s redefining what’s possible in energy, materials, and manufacturing. We’re not just imagining the future — we’re building it today with breakthrough technologies that are changing how products are made and how industries innovate.

title: Observability Engineer
description:
**About the Company** 




  





  





 At FDJ UNITED, we don't just follow the game, we reinvent it.FDJ UNITED is one of Europe’s leading betting and gaming operators, with a vast portfolio of iconic brands and a reputation for technological excellence. With more than 5,000 employees and a presence in around fifteen regulated markets, the Group offers a diversified, responsible range of games, both under exclusive rights and open to competition. We set new standards, proving that entertainment and safety can go hand in hand. Here, you’ll work alongside a team of passionate individuals dedicated to delivering the best and safest entertaining experiences for our customers every day.We’re looking for bold people who are eager to succeed and ready to level-up the game. If you thrive on innovation, embrace challenges, and want to make a real impact at all levels, FDJ UNITED is your playing field.Join us in shaping the future of gaming. Are you ready to LEVEL-UP THE GAME?
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 We are looking for a talented and driven Site Reliability Engineer (Observability Engineer) to join our team and play a key role in building the next generation of our high-performance observability framework.In this role, you will be at the heart of designing, developing, and operating the systems that give our engineering organisation deep visibility into the health, performance, and reliability of our products and infrastructure. You will work closely with engineering teams across the business to ensure our observability stack is scalable, reliable, and fit for purpose in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment.The current focus of the framework is built around VictoriaLogs and VictoriaMetrics, with a strong emphasis on OpenTelemetry for metrics and log ingestion. You will help shape how this framework evolves and be a hands-on contributor to its ongoing development, as well as help maintain this in a high traffic production site.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Designing and developing a next-generation, high-performance observability platform using modern tooling and best practices.
* Driving the adoption and implementation of OpenTelemetry (OTEL/OTLP) for metrics and log ingestion across the organisation.
* Building and maintaining Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management pipelines to automate platform operations.
* Contributing to CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows to support continuous delivery of observability components.
* Owning and improving the reliability, scalability, and performance of the observability stack.
* Collaborating with engineering teams to define and track Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and establish reliability standards.
* Participating in code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical planning sessions.
* Supporting capacity planning, release processes, and change management practices.
* Championing an automation-first mindset and contributing to a culture of operational excellence.



  





  





**Required Skills** 




  





  





**Infrastructure & Configuration Management** 



* Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code, specifically Terraform
* Configuration management experience using Ansible and/or Chef



  





**Coding Skills** 



* Strong scripting and development capabilities in Bash, Python, and Go
* Experience with Rust and/or Java is a nice to have



  





**CI/CD & Version Control** 



* Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Git and GitLab
* Experience with ArgoCD and/or Jenkins for CI/CD pipeline management



  





**Monitoring & Observability** 



* Metrics platforms: Prometheus, Mimir, InfluxDB, VictoriaMetrics
* Log aggregation: Splunk, Loki, Elasticsearch, VictoriaLogs
* Visualisation: Grafana
* Log forwarding: FluentBit, Vector.dev
* OpenTelemetry (OTEL/OTLP): Metrics and log pipeline experience



  





**Containers & Orchestration** 



* Strong experience with Docker and/or Podman
* Kubernetes (including workload management and cluster operations)
* Helm for Kubernetes package management



  





**Cloud** 



* Hands-on experience with AWS



  





**Core Concepts & Principles** 




  




* You'll need a solid understanding and proven experience of the following:
* Systems Architecture: ability to design and reason about complex distributed systems
* Networking principles: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, proxies, and beyond
* TSDB (Time Series Database) principles: understanding of storage, retention, cardinality, and query patterns
* Logging principles: structured logging, log pipelines, and log management at scale
* Messaging queues: pub/sub patterns, event-driven architectures
* Clustering principles: high availability, fault tolerance, distributed coordination
* Load balancing: strategies, implementations, and traffic management
* API / JSON principles: RESTful APIs, data serialisation, and integration patterns
* Caching mechanisms: In-memory caching, external caches, and cache invalidation strategies
* Code reviews: Contributing to and leading thoughtful, constructive reviews
* Testing and documentation: Writing quality tests and clear technical documentation
* Agile mindset: Comfortable working in iterative, collaborative delivery environments
* Automation mindset: Defaulting to automation and repeatability in everything you build



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 




  





 Nice to Have
 


* Experience with AI concepts and tooling, including the creation of MCP's and agent Skills
* Microservices architecture: Design patterns, service meshes, inter-service communication



  





**Operational Experience** 



* Change Management: Structured approaches to managing infrastructure and service changes
* Service Level Indicators (SLIs): Defining, measuring, and acting on reliability metrics
* Capacity Planning: Forecasting infrastructure needs based on usage trends and growth
* Release Processes: Experience with progressive delivery, feature flags, and rollback strategies



  





  





 We believe talent knows no boundaries. Our hiring process focuses solely on your skills, experience, and potential to contribute to our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and evaluate each candidate based on merit, regardless of personal characteristics as the age, gender, origin, religion, sexual orientation, neurodiversity or disability.

title: Data Engineer
description:
*Vill du vara med och framtidssäkra ett av ATG:s viktigaste områden genom att bygga nästa generations Data Warehouse i molnet? Trivs du i en tekniskt avancerad miljö där datamodellering, kvalitet och skalbarhet står i fokus? Då kan rollen vara rätt för dig. Hos oss blir du en nyckelperson i transformationen från vårt befintliga Oracle on‑prem Data Warehouse till en modern molnbaserad lösning i Snowflake och AWS.* 




  





**I rollen får du:** 



* Vidareutveckla Data Warehouse i Snowflake och AWS
* Arbeta med datamodellering, transformationer och robusta dataflöden
* Bygga och optimera ETL/ELT‑processer
* Delta i förflyttningen från Oracle till Snowflake
* Integrera datakällor och möjliggöra nya dataflöden och use cases
* Bidra till principer för datamodellering och governance
* Påverka tekniska beslut och teamets arbetssätt



  





 Som Data Engineer inom Data Warehouse hos ATG blir du en nyckelperson i moderniseringen av vårt centrala Data Warehouse. Plattformen är central för ATG:S datadrivna arbete och används för analys, rapportering och beslutsstöd i hela organisation. Du kommer in i en fas där vi migrerar från Oracle on-prem till Snowflake i AWS och nu fortsätter bygga en modern, skalbar och framtidssäkrad lösning i molnet. Rollen ger stort ansvar och möjlighet att påverka teknik, arkitektur och arbetssätt. Du arbetar i ett engagerat team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och kontinuerlig utveckling är en naturlig del av vardagen.
 



  





**Är det här du?** 




 Vi söker dig som tycker att data engineering är som mest spännande när tekniken gör verklig nytta. Du är trygg i SQL och datamodellering, gillar att bygga hållbara och kvalitetssäkrade lösningar och har ett genuint intresse för hur data kan struktureras och görs tillgänglig effektivt. Du trivs med ansvar, nära samarbete och att bidra till både teknik och arbetssätt. Du är analytisk, lösningsorienterad och nyfiken, med förståelse för kvalitet och stabilitet i affärskritiska miljöer.
 



  





 Vi ser att du har:
 


* Erfarenhet av Data Engineering/Data Warehouse
* Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL och datamodellering
* Erfarenhet av ETL/ELT-flöden
* Erfarenhet av Snowflake eller moderna cloud-DW
* Erfarenhet av AWS eller annan molnplattform
* Vana av Git och moderna utvecklingsflöden
* Förståelse för datakvalitet, prestandaoptimering och automatiserade tester
* God kommunikativ förmåga på engelska (svenska meriterande)
* Ett pragmatiskt och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt i samarbete med andra team



 Meriterande:
 


* Data Vault eller andra modelleringsmetoder
* dbt eller liknande transformationsverktyg
* Orchestration-verktyg som Airflow eller motsvarande
* Python eller annat språk för data engineering
* Erfarenhet av affärskritiska miljöer med höga krav på stabilitet och tillgänglighet



  





 Som person är du prestigelös, driven och samarbetsorienterad och bidrar till en lärande kultur i teamet.
 



  





**”Jag tror på att människor utvecklas bäst när de känner trygghet, får förtroende och har möjlighet att påverka.”** 




 Jag har arbetat i flera roller inom IT – utvecklare, produktägare och scrum master – vilket gett mig en bred förståelse för både tekniken och människorna bakom leveransen. Idag drivs jag av att stötta individer och team i deras utveckling och skapa en miljö där vi lär av varandra och bygger hållbara lösningar. Det som gör rollen extra spännande är vår pågående transformation till ett modernt Data Warehouse i Snowflake och AWS, där du får stor möjlighet att påverka teknik och arbetssätt. När jag inte jobbar tycker jag om att resa och upptäcka nya platser – något som ger energi och nya perspektiv.
 



**Therese Göransson, Manager IT - DW, Financial & EWS** 




  





**We are the game** 




 I mer än 50 år har vi på ATG levererat spänning och underhållning till svenska folket. Vi drivs av att trygga den svenska hästnäringen och att fortsatt vara ett ansvarsfullt spelbolag i framkant. Vår vision är att leverera världens bästa spelupplevelse. Hos oss är du en del av en innovativ miljö – med hjälp av den senaste tekniken utvecklar vi spelupplevelser i världsklass. Självledarskap och kompetensutveckling är viktiga delar för oss. Sedan starten 1974 har vi byggt och förvaltat systemen för våra produkter som hanterar 4 500 000 transaktioner per dag.
 



  





**Join the game!** 




 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via vår rekryteringsportal antingen med ditt cv eller din LinkedIn-profil – det som är enklast och smidigast för dig. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår karriärsida och tveka inte att höra av dig om du har frågor om tjänsten.
 



  





 Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning och kommer att göra en bakgrundskontroll för denna roll. Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor vid Solvalla, alldeles intill travbanan. Vi har ett flexibelt arbetssätt vilket innebär att du har möjlighet att kombinera distansarbete med arbete från kontoret. Var med och bygg världens bästa spelupplevelse tillsammans med oss!

title: Senior Engineer Remote Connectivity and IoT
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Senior Engineer Remote Connectivity and IoT** 
 to help us build secure, reliable, and scalable connectivity solutions for products used in the field.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who really understands IoT and remote connectivity, not just in theory, but in practice. We’re looking for a senior technical person who can help define how we should build connected solutions going forward, while also being comfortable getting into the details when needed.
   

  

 You work closely with backend developers and a Product Owner focused on remote connectivity. You’ll act as a technical expert in the team, supporting both roadmap discussions and day-to-day technical decisions.
   

  

 Location: Sundbyberg, Sweden.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and improve secure and reliable connectivity solutions for products connected to cloud platforms and remote systems.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Europe's public institutions serve hundreds of millions of people, and most lack the AI infrastructure to do it well. Intric is changing that. Our sovereign AI platform is already used by 70+ municipalities, governments, and institutions. We've built a leading position in Sweden and are expanding across Europe.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Be the technical owner within customer engagements, working alongside sales and customer success from pre-sales through go-live
* Build integrations across APIs, authentication systems, data pipelines, and document platforms
* Deploy Intric in on-prem and private cloud environments with strict security requirements
* Debug what no one else can figure out, in environments with limited tooling and high constraints
* Turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions customers rely on daily
* Prioritize ruthlessly across competing demands, from a position of knowledge rather than whoever is loudest
* Feed real-world deployment insights back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap


**Who you are**
 You've shipped things that other people depend on. You've been on-call when they broke. You've dealt with real production risk, real failure, and end-to-end ownership without a safety net. That background is what makes the rest of this possible.
   

  

* You work across the full stack without needing to hand off: frontend, backend, infrastructure, AI layer, GitOps, networking, protocols, raw API work
* You take ownership of customer outcomes, not individual tasks. If the customer isn't reaching their goal, that's your problem to solve.
* You can say no to the wrong thing and yes to the right one, even under pressure from the customer.
* You can explain a technical decision to a non-technical department manager and defend it to their engineers, often in the same meeting
* You're effective in ambiguous, under-documented, high-constraint environments


**Fluent** 
**Swedish and English are both required for this role.**
 Your title might have been Implementation Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or something else entirely. What matters is what you actually did: owning delivery in customer environments, end to end, with real stakes attached.
   

  

**What You'll Gain**
 You'll build a combination that's hard to find elsewhere: production-level AI deployment experience in high-security environments, across multiple industries, with direct ownership of customer outcomes from start to finish.
   

  

* Hands-on experience deploying AI in production-critical, high-security environments
* Exposure to complex enterprise architectures across sectors and countries
* Direct influence on product direction through real deployment feedback


**What this job actually looks like**
**Up to 80% of your work happens in customer environments, alongside their technical teams primarly across Sweden with some cross-Nordics travel as projects require** 
 . You learn their systems, integrate the platform, and own the outcome from the first sales conversation through go-live and beyond.
   

  

 The environment spans Python, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, self-hosted LLMs, and Svelte. You won't use all of it on every project, but you need to move across the stack as the situation demands. You use AI tools well and quickly, but your value is the judgment behind them: knowing what to build, how to prioritize, and when to push back.
   

  

 Your default is finding the path, not describing the obstacle. Sometimes that means telling a customer that what they're asking for is the wrong thing to build. Both are part of the job.
   

  

**Why Intric**
* One of Europe's most trusted AI platforms for regulated organizations
* Funded and growing: you're joining before the scale curve, not after
* High ownership and decision-making authority from day one
* A team that takes quality, security, and long-term trust seriously


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and equity
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension) with fund choice and advisory meetings, plus sjukförsäkring, premiebefrielse, TFA, and TGL
* 25 days paid vacation
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)

title: Wireless AI Algorithm Engineer
description:
We seek a
 **Wireless Algorithm Engineer with a strong background in AI research to join the Wireless Algorithm Lab at Huawei R&D in Stockholm** 
 .
 



  





 The lab conducts advanced research on wireless algorithms for 5G-Advanced products and future 6G communication systems. By deeply integrating artificial intelligence with wireless communications, they aim to explore intelligent algorithms, data-driven approaches, and AI-native technologies for next-generation wireless systems, and to drive promising research outcomes toward practical systems and products.
 



 The successful candidate should have received systematic academic training in machine learning, deep learning, or related areas, and should be capable of independently conducting cutting-edge AI research.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Research and develop innovative
 **AI/ML algorithms and models** 
 for next-generation wireless communication systems, with applications to optimisation, prediction, and decision-making.
* Build and improve simulation environments, datasets, evaluation frameworks, and experimental methodologies required for algorithm research.
* Track state-of-the-art developments in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and wireless communications, identify promising research directions, and formulate innovative research topics.



  





**Qualifications** 



* **PhD in** 
**Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics** 
 , or a related field.·
 **Strong academic background in AI/ML** 
 with a deep and systematic understanding of the field. Expertise in AI research areas, such as deep learning, representation learning, generative models, sequence modeling, graph learning, reinforcement learning, foundation models, transfer learning, continual learning, or other emerging machine learning technologies.
* Proficiency in
 **Python** 
 , with hands-on research experience using mainstream deep learning frameworks such as
 **PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow** 
 ;
* Strong mathematical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary research and engineering teams.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* A sustained track record of high-quality publications in leading AI/ML conferences or journals;
* Experience applying advanced AI methods to communications, signal processing, control, or other complex engineering systems;
* Industrial R&D experience with the ability to balance frontier research value with practical algorithm implementation and deployment considerations.



  





 This is a full-time consultant position.
 



  





 Please get in touch wth Karin Persson if you have any questions.

title: Data Engineer
description:
ALTEN Sweden is looking for a
 **Data Engineer** 
 with strong expertise in
 **Databricks, cloud platforms, and modern data engineering** 
 to join an exciting long-term assignment. You will work with our Swedish and international clients to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and cloud-based solutions. Your expertise in Databricks, multi-cloud platforms, and SQL will enable organizations to harness data for innovation, efficiency, and decision-making. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver tailored data architectures that align with client needs in industries like automotive, engineering, banking, IT, and telecom.
 



  





**WHAT DO WE OFFER
 
 ?** 




 As a consultant at ALTEN, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging and exciting projects with some of our key clients, with:
 


* Technical challenges and development opportunities.
* An inspiring community and the chance to contribute to a sustainable future.
* Supportive and coaching leadership.
* The possibility to work across various industries where our clients operate.
* A personal training budget for internal or external courses.



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE**




 This role focuses on designing, building, and managing data pipelines that efficiently collect, transform, and deliver data from various sources to cloud-based or hybrid storage solutions. The professional ensures that data remains accessible, reliable, and optimized for analysis and business decision-making. A significant aspect of the role involves working with large-scale data processing frameworks to support analytics and machine learning initiatives. Strong SQL expertise is essential for writing and refining queries to guarantee high performance and data accuracy in client projects.
 



  





 The position also emphasizes collaboration, as the individual will work closely with data scientists, analysts, and business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions that drive actionable insights. Additionally, the role includes implementing data governance practices to ensure compliance with Swedish and EU regulations, such as GDPR, while maintaining robust data security and metadata management.
 



  





**Required competencies** 




  




* Experience: 5+ years as a Data Engineer or in a similar role.
* SQL: Strong skills in advanced querying, optimization, and troubleshooting.
* Databricks: Hands-on experience with Delta Lake, Spark, and cluster management.
* Multi-Cloud: Proficiency in AWS, Azure, or GCP (certifications are a plus).
* Programming: Experience with Python, Scala, or PySpark for data processing.
* Big Data Technologies: Familiarity with Hadoop, Kafka, or Snowflake.
* Data Modeling: Knowledge of dimensional modeling, star schema, and warehouse design.



  





**Nice-to-Have** 



* Experience with MLOps or deploying machine learning models.
* Knowledge of data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik).
* Familiarity with Swedish business culture and regulations.



  





**ABOUT ALTEN**




 ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies, with over 57,000 employees across approximately 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the entire product development chain for leading companies in several industries including Automotive, Defense & Security, Energy, Industrial Equipment, Public Sector, and Life Sciences.
 



 In Sweden, we are approximately 1,300 dedicated employees spread across 9 offices in cities ranging from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.
 



 For the fifth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden’s most attractive employers by
 *Karriärföretagen* 
 for five consecutive years — an award for companies offering unique career and development opportunities.
 



  





 Welcome to read more about us at alten.se

title: Microstrategy  & Businessobjects Specialist
description:
**About Cognizant**
 Cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, helping organizations modernize technology, reimagine processes, and transform experiences so they stay ahead in a fast-changing world. With over 300,000 associates globally, Cognizant combines a passion for client satisfaction, technology innovation, deep industry and business process expertise, and a global, collaborative workforce that embodies the future of work. We are consistently listed among the most admired companies in the world and among the best companies to work for. Our culture is built on a foundation of transparency, inclusion, and collaboration — empowering our people to grow and thrive both professionally and personally. At Cognizant, you won't just be part of a company; you'll be part of a community that is shaping the future of industries across the globe.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for a senior BI lead who can own the end-to-end design, development and administration of MicroStrategy and SAP BusinessObjects platforms. The candidate will lead a team of BI developers, drive solution architecture, and work closely with business stakeholders to deliver scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
