title: Sr. Product Engineer | Agentic Platform
description:
At TV4, our engineers build and operate the technology behind TV4 Play and MTV Katsomo, used by millions of people every week.
   

  

 Within Engineering Platform, we are now building an internal agentic platform for our engineering organisation. We are looking for a
 **Sr. Product Engineer** 
 to help build it.
   

  

***Before you apply***
*To be considered, you need to* 
***already have the right to work and reside in Sweden***
*and be able to work office-first from Stockholm. We are not able to offer relocation or visa sponsorship for this role.*
**What We Are Building**
 AI-assisted development is already part of everyday engineering at TV4. We are now taking the next step: building a platform where agents can take on meaningful parts of the software development lifecycle.
   

  

 The users are our own engineers.
   

  

 The work involves questions around how agents interact with our development environments, tools and systems. Which tasks should be delegated to agents? What information do they need? How do we know that an agent actually did a good job? Where do we need human judgment?
   

  

 Much of this is still being figured out. We want to test ideas, put useful solutions in the hands of engineers and learn from how they work in practice.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 You will work in a small team building the Agentic Platform from exploration through production.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Build features and workflows used by engineers across TV4
* Work directly with developers to understand problems and test solutions
* Build integrations with repositories, development environments and internal systems
* Prototype when the solution is unclear and take useful ideas into production
* Take responsibility for your work in production, including reliability, observability and failure modes
* Contribute to both technical and product decisions


 This is a hands-on engineering role. Depending on the problem, you may work on an API, an integration, a developer interface, infrastructure or an agent workflow.
   

  

**About You**
 You are an experienced software engineer with a broad technical foundation. You have built and operated software in production and are comfortable taking responsibility beyond implementation.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who wants to build this as a
 **product** 
 , not just as tooling. You treat APIs, workflows and developer interfaces as products, care about the engineers using them, and can turn recurring problems into capabilities that work across teams.
   

  

 You should also be comfortable working in an area where many answers are still unknown.
   

  

 We are looking for:
   

  

* Broad software engineering experience across more than one part of the stack
* Experience with system design, APIs and modern cloud environments
* Strong engineering judgment and the ability to make technical trade-offs
* Experience taking problems from exploration to production
* An interest in developer experience and internal platforms
* Experience integrating coding agents into how you work today
* Experimentation with areas such as agentic workflows, context engineering, MCP, tool use, evaluation, observability or automation
* The ability to explain technical reasoning clearly and work across team boundaries


 Deep expertise in a particular language or framework is not important.
   

  

 You also do not need years of experience building AI infrastructure. The field is moving too quickly for that to be a particularly useful requirement. We care more about strong engineering fundamentals and whether you are already exploring what agentic development means in practice.
   

  

**The engineering challenge**
 Agents are probabilistic. They make mistakes, need the right context and interact with systems that have real permissions and production consequences.
   

  

 We are interested in where agents genuinely improve engineering work, not in adding them everywhere because we can.
   

  

**Technical environment**
 Depending on what you work on, you may encounter:
   

  

* Go, TypeScript, Node.js and Python
* AWS and Kubernetes
* Terraform and GitHub Actions
* APIs, CLI tooling and MCP
* Claude Code, OpenAI Codex and other coding agents
* PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and OpenSearch
* Observability and evaluation tooling


 The exact stack matters less than being able to understand a problem and work effectively in the technology needed to solve it.
   

  

**What TV4 Offers**
* A senior engineering role with significant influence over a platform used across our engineering organisation
* Short paths from idea to decision and high autonomy
* Experienced engineering colleagues and technically challenging problems
* Collective agreement, occupational pension, insurance and wellness allowance
* Benify, your choice of phone and MacBook Pro
* Office with gym, restaurant and garage


**Practical information**
**Working model:** 
 Office-first, with four days per week in the office
   

  

**Employment:** 
 Permanent position with a six-month probationary period
   

  

**Union agreement:** 
 Unionen
   

  

**Background check:** 
 Part of the recruitment process

Together, we continue to develop one of Sweden’s most widely used delivery services—and you will play a key leadership role in shaping the future of our engineering organization and delivery platforms!
   

  

**Some of the things you will do**
* Architect next-generation systems: Lead the technical design, scalability, and performance of our crucial order-handling backbone.
* Integrate AI & modern tech: Drive the adoption of AI-powered tools, smart workflows, and modern technologies to enhance system performance, automated processes, and developer workflows.
* Drive technical strategy & mentor: Partner closely with product management and cross-functional stakeholders to align technical architecture with business goals while mentoring junior and mid-level team members.
* Champion innovation: Stay ahead of industry trends, evaluate new technologies, and introduce best practices that elevate our engineering standards.
* System evolution & optimization: Continuously review, audit, and refactor our distributed architecture to maximize reliability, maintainability, and efficiency.
* Collaborative leadership: Lead by example in an autonomous environment that embraces pair/mob programming, high-standard code reviews, and collective technical problem-solving.


**Your future team**
 The Orders team is responsible for developing and maintaining the core engine of our business: order handling. This involves everything from creating and managing orders to ensuring their successful completion and everything in between. By driving technical excellence in this domain, you will empower and support development teams across Instabee.
   

  

 You will join a focused, high-impact team supported by an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, and a Staff Engineer. We operate with high autonomy, relying on senior expertise to make high-leverage architectural decisions foundational to Instabee's growth.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**

* Core Tech Stack: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript.
* Deep Database Experience: Deep expertise with MongoDB (or equivalent document/NoSQL/relational database technologies), including query optimization and schema design for high-scale applications.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Strong proficiency with Kubernetes and production experience with GCP (Google Cloud Platform) or similar cloud infrastructure.
* AI Savvy: A forward-thinking, proactive approach to leveraging AI capabilities, LLMs, or developer automation to optimize backend engineering and business operations.
* Technical Leadership & Learning: A continuous-learning mindset paired with the ability to drive technical initiatives from conception to delivery.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly articulate complex architectural concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

**What You’ll Get**
 We promise you’ll be challenged, rapidly expand your technical reach, and work alongside deeply talented colleagues. If you thrive in high-ownership, adaptable environments and enjoy setting technical direction and best practices, Instabee is the place for you.
   

  

**Alongside Standard Competitive Benefits, We Offer**

 **Brand-New Office** 
 : More Space for Our Brilliant People. Soon moving into our new Stockholm HQ, designed to bring our people together to collaborate, connect, create and deliver.

 🏓

 Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and a private Karaoke Room.

 6 months of parental pay support so you can focus on your family.
   

  

 🎂
 **Birthday Off:** 
 Enjoy your special day on us with an extra day off every year.
   

  

 ⏰
 **Flexible Hybrid Setup:** 
 Working hours designed to adapt to your life.
   

  

**Ready to build the future of logistics with us?**
 If you're a senior engineer who loves solving complex backend challenges, experimenting with modern tech, and making an impact at scale, we’d love to meet you. Send in your application and let’s start the conversation!
   

  

**Diversity & Inclusion**
 Diversity and inclusion are at the heart of our culture. We are committed to building an inclusive work environment where every perspective is valued and every team member has the opportunity to thrive and reach their full potential.
   

  

**Get to know us**
 Founded in 2022 through the merger of Budbee and Instabox, Instabee brings together three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. We serve millions of consumers across Europe with convenient, smart delivery solutions and are on track to become Europe’s leading e-commerce enabler.
   

  

 As our logistics network and business complexity expand across Scandinavia and continental Europe, we need senior engineering talent ready to architect for scale and build the future with us.
   

  

*Note: This recruitment process includes background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys for public criminal records, handled confidentially in accordance with Swedish recruitment procedures.*
*Employment for this role will be with Instabox Group AB.*
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

**Rollbeskrivning**

 Uppdragsbeskrivning:
   

  

 Kund söker en driven och framåtsträvande senior data engineer till Digitaliseringsenheten. Enheten ingår i avdelningen för verksamhetsstöd och ansvarar för verksamhetsnära digitala lösningar som stöder myndighetens kärnverksamhet.

 Som senior data engineer blir du en nyckelperson i utvecklingen och förvaltningen av vårt datalager och våra BI-lösningar. Du kommer att driva tekniska beslut, optimera dataprocesser och säkerställa robusta, långsiktiga lösningar som skapar värde för verksamheten samt analysera och lösa komplexa problem på djupet.
   

  

 Placering: kunds kontor i Stockholm men med möjlighet till visst distansarbete.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
* Designa, utveckla och underhålla datalager, ETL-flöden och SSAS-kuber för rapportering och analys.
* Bygga datamodeller i SSAS som möjliggör effektiva och användarvänliga Power BI-lösningar.
* Felsöka, analysera och lösa komplexa problem i datalager och dataprocesser, från rotorsak till färdig lösning.
* Driva tekniska beslut kring arkitektur, datamodellering, datakvalitet och optimering av kuber.

 Krav
   

  

 Skallkrav:

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Platform & Partner Experience
description:
We design Spotify's consumer experience — end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints — from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
   

  

 Platform & Partner Experience (PPX) sits within the Experience Mission, shaping how Spotify shows up across devices, platforms, and partner ecosystems. We build the foundations that power seamless integrations — from smart speakers to cars to AI agents — while ensuring every interaction feels personal, reliable, and unmistakably Spotify.
   

  

 As a Senior Staff Engineer, you'll advance how our systems power partner experiences at scale, tackling complex challenges that span teams, systems and organizational boundaries. You will work closely with platform, infrastructure, and product teams across the company to create shared foundations, streamline our architecture and unlock new experiences for our users and partners.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and development of systems that enable and enhance partner and platform experiences across devices and integrations
* Drive complex technical initiatives that span multiple studios or a full mission — particularly where coordination cost, architectural sprawl, or competing local optimizations are part of the problem
* Create leverage by unifying fragmented approaches, retiring duplicative systems, and establishing the standards and platforms that enable multiple studios move faster without reinventing foundations — judging where consolidation creates leverage and where local autonomy is the better choice
* Define and influence technical strategy across organizational boundaries and bring other senior engineers along in executing it
* Collaborate with engineering, product and design leaders across the Experience Mission and beyond to identify shared opportunities, align technical direction and reduce duplication
* Shape how AI transforms the software development lifecycle and pioneer AI-native workflows and capabilities that bridge engineering, product, and design


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have deep experience designing, building and operating distributed systems that serve users at scale
* You have a strong track record of technical leadership — influencing and shaping architecture decisions across teams, and driving organizational change in how software gets built
* You thrive in complex, ambiguous problem spaces and can identify where technical investment will create the greatest leverage across teams and systems
* You care deeply about reliable, high-quality user experiences powered by data and personalization
* You actively explore how AI reshapes how we build, not just what we build, and can turn emerging capabilities into practical improvements in how teams work
* You bring a thoughtful, collaborative, inclusive mindset and actively contribute to a positive team culture


 Where You Will Be
   

  

* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best. For this role, you can be based anywhere in EMEA where Spotify has a work location (excluding France due to on-call restrictions).
* The team collaborates within Central European and GMT time zones.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
**TL;DR** 
 We are seeking an Application Security Engineer to champion security across our entire development lifecycle. You’ll play a pivotal role in reviewing code, designing secure features, and mentoring engineers, ensuring security is at the heart of everything we build. If you’re passionate about application security, thrive on close collaboration with developers, and want to do the work of your life, this is your opportunity
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
* 5+ years of experience in application security, securing cloud-native environments at product-focused tech companies, high-growth startups, or leading AI labs.
* Strong programming and engineering skills.
* Deep expertise in application security: secure code review, threat modeling, SAST/DAST, supply chain security, product patching, and vulnerability management.
* Strong background in securing engineering infrastructure: CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, service-to-service authentication, containerized workloads, and public cloud platforms.
* Hands-on experience collaborating with developers to design and implement security features and best practices.
* Passion for educating and mentoring engineers on secure coding, vulnerability remediation, and emerging threats.
* Systems mindset: comfortable reading and contributing to codebases, building security tooling, and integrating security into engineering workflows.
* Bonus: Experience building internal security tools or contributing to open-source security projects.


**What You’ll Do**
* Conduct secure code reviews, threat modeling, and architecture assessments to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities early.
* Work closely with engineering teams to design and implement security features, provide actionable feedback, and ensure security is embedded in product development.
* Lead security training, workshops, and 1:1 mentoring to upskill developers and foster a security-first culture.
* Integrate SAST/DAST and supply chain security tools into our CI/CD pipelines for continuous, automated protection.
* Detect, triage, and respond to application vulnerabilities and incidents, driving remediation and continuous improvement.
* Monitor and address emerging risks in AI infrastructure, LLM pipelines, and third-party dependencies.
* Secure the last piece of software.


**Our Tech Stack**
* Frontend: React and Typescript
* Backend: Golang and Rust
* Cloud: Cloudflare, Google Cloud, AWS, Terraform
* DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, observability, infrastructure-as-code


 And always exploring what’s next.
   

  

**How To Apply**
* Please submit your application in English—our working language at Lovable.
* We’re committed to fair and equal treatment for all candidates. If you’re interested, apply via our careers portal

title: Sveriges utrikes underrättelsetjänst söker verksamhetsutvecklare
company: Kommittén för bildandet av en utrikesunderrättelsetjänst
description:
Vill du vara med och bidra i det svenska underrättelsesamhället? Nu bildas Sveriges utrikes underrättelsetjänst (UND) som en del i underrättelsereformen. Vi bygger upp en helt ny myndighet för att stärka Sveriges samlade förmåga att möta en bred och komplex hotbild som snabbt utvecklas och förändras.
   

  





**Beskrivning**




 Vi söker en eller flera erfarna verksamhetsutvecklare till avdelningen för innovation och teknik. Dina uppgifter syftar till att bidra till utvecklingen av myndighetens digitala förmåga. Dina uppgifter kommer också att omfatta kompetensutvecklingsinsatser för medarbetare samt externa samverkan med andra myndigheter och organisationer.
   

  





**Arbetsuppgifter**




 Du kommer att arbeta nära verksamheten med att utveckla arbetssätt och initiativ inom digitalisering och innovation. Arbetet omfattar att stödja utvecklingen av myndighetens digitaliserings- och innovationsarbete. Det ingår också att bidra till utveckling av utbildningar och långsiktig kompetensutveckling inom dina områden, att initiera och koordinera samverkansprojekt med externa aktörer samt att ge stöd till ledningen i frågor som rör ny teknik, AI och digital transformation.
   

  





**Kvalifikationer**




 Du har en akademisk examen eller motsvarande som arbetsgivaren bedömer är relevant för tjänsten. Du har erfarenhet av att leda komplexa projekt eller drivit förändringsarbete inom verksamhetstransformation och digital utveckling. Du har också erfarenhet från säkerhets- eller underrättelsetjänst.
   

  





 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från ledande befattning och internationellt samarbete.
   

  





 Som person är du initiativtagande och utvecklingsorienterad med ett strukturerat arbetssätt. Du har hög integritet, styrs av etik och värderingar i ditt arbete. Du har förmågan att väga samman komplex information och har ett gott omdöme vid vägval och prioriteringar. Du har god förmåga att se helheter och har ett brett, strategiskt perspektiv på frågor. Du är prestigelös och tillmötesgående i ditt bemötande och är bra på att hitta och leverera lösningar.
   

  





**Övrig information**




 Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning, provanställning på sex månader tillämpas som huvudregel.
   

  





 Du behöver vara svensk medborgare för att arbeta vid UND och tjänsten är placerad i säkerhetsklass. Säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras före beslut om anställning.
   

  





 För frågor kontakta Charlotte Ryrberg eller Charlotta Gustafsson, tel. 08-405 10 00.
   

  





 Välkommen med din ansökan senast den5 november 2026.
   

  





**Sveriges utrikes underrättelsetjänst (UND)** 
  är en ny myndighet som ska inleda sin verksamhet den 1 januari 2027 och därefter successivt växa.
   

  





 UND kommer att vara en nationell underrättelseresurs som i fred, kris och krig stödjer svensk utrikes-, säkerhets- och försvarspolitik. Genom att upptäcka, identifiera och förvarna om yttre hot kommer myndigheten att främja Sveriges nationella säkerhetsintressen och våra allierades säkerhet. Myndighetens uppgift är att stödja regeringen, Regeringskansliet och andra myndigheter.
   

  





 Myndigheten kommer vara lokaliserad i Stockholmsområdet.

title: Mobile Engineering Manager
description:
**What will you do?** 




 As a Mobile Engineering Manager at Rebtel, you will lead the engineers behind our iOS and Android apps, combining hands-on native mobile development with coaching and team leadership. Your daily work will focus on building high-quality mobile experiences, driving technical excellence, and helping engineers grow in their craft. You will also champion the effective use of AI-assisted development to improve productivity while maintaining strong engineering standards and ownership.
 



  





 This is not a management-only role. You will write and review production code, pair with engineers, and help solve difficult technical problems while taking responsibility for the team's development and delivery. Your impact will come from both what you build and how you help others grow.
 



  





**Areas Of Ownership** 



* Coach and develop engineers through regular one-to-ones, clear feedback and career development. Help people strengthen their technical judgment, grow their skills and take greater ownership.
* Stay hands-on with native development. Write and review production code, pair with engineers, and help investigate challenging bugs and performance issues using native platform tools.
* Help the team use AI effectively. Lead by example with AI-assisted development tools, share practical approaches and coach engineers to critically evaluate outputs while maintaining code quality, security and ownership.
* Drive native app excellence. Set high standards for performance, stability, accessibility and user experience across iOS and Android. Guide technical decisions, architecture, testing and release practices.
* Collaborate across teams. Work closely with Product, Design and Backend Engineering to turn customer needs into clear priorities, deliver valuable features and balance short-term goals with long-term app quality.
* Build a culture of ownership and accountability. Hire and develop great engineers, set clear expectations and create an environment where people take initiative, solve problems and take pride in what they deliver.



**Requirements** 



* You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. English is our working language, but you'll hear many different languages in our Stockholm office.
* A strong track record as a native mobile engineer, with production iOS or Android apps you have personally designed, built and shipped.
* Deep hands-on expertise in native iOS development (Swift/Objective-C) or Android development (Kotlin/Java). You understand native architecture, UI, app lifecycle, concurrency, performance and debugging, and are comfortable contributing production code today. You can guide technical decisions across both platforms, although equal expertise in both is not required. Experience limited to React Native or other cross-platform frameworks does not meet this requirement.
* Experience leading and developing engineers, including coaching, giving feedback, supporting career growth and managing performance. You know how to stay technically involved without taking over.
* Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools. You understand where they add value, where they fall short and how to validate their output.
* Strong engineering judgment and the ability to make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing quality, delivery and long-term maintainability.



  





**Why Rebtel?** 




 Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.
 



 This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.
 



  





**Benefits** 




 At Rebtel, you are the most important asset and we strive to provide a comprehensive package of benefits and perks that enhance your well-being and work experience. Here are some of the things you can expect from us:
 


* Pension Plan
* Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Occupational insurance
* Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)
* Discount on gym memberships
* Bonus program
* Extra parental pay
* 30 days annual vacation
* Monday breakfasts
* Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.



  





*We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

title: Researcher in AI-Assisted and Computational Social Science Research
description:
Political science at the Swedish Defence University is unique in its special focus on security and crisis management. The subject is at the same time theoretically broad, and draws on a wide range of related fields, such as international relations, political communication, public administration, and political theory as well as drawing inspiration from other research within and outside of political science.
   

  

**Description**
 The position is focused on AI-assisted social science research, computational social science and quantitative methods. The research may, for example, address information influence, political and strategic communication, media and narratives.
   

  

 A central part of the position is to develop and evaluate scientifically rigorous ways of using large language models (LLMs) and other AI-based methods in social science research.
   

  

 The researcher will work in a team that conducts commissioned research on information influence and disinformation.
   

  

 Duties
   

  

 The researcher is expected to plan and conduct both independent and collaborative research and to contribute to scientific publications and conference presentations.
   

  

 The researcher will work in a research team conducting commissioned research on information influence and disinformation. A central part of the position is also to strengthen the research group’s competence in AI-assisted research, computational social science and quantitative methods. The researcher is therefore expected to actively train and supervise other researchers in the group and to contribute to building long-term methodological capacity.
   

  

**Duties Include, Among Other Things**
* plan and conduct independent and collaborative research using AI-based, computational and quantitative methods;
* develop and evaluate methods involving LLMs, quantitative text analysis, machine learning and NLP;
* explore the use of local and open-source language models with research data, with particular attention to validation and reproducibility;
* strengthen the research group’s methodological competence through workshops, individual guidance, and support in programming and analysis;
* contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations and research funding applications.


**Qualifications**
 Applicants must hold a doctoral degree, or an equivalent international degree.
   

  

**The Following Qualifications Are Also Required**
* experience of quantitative and/or computational social science methods, including computational text and/or image analysis and processing of social media/platform data, as well as the ability to use Python and/or R for analysis and research
* experience of machine learning, NLP or quantitative text analysis, with particular emphasis on LLM-based methods
* a good understanding of research design, validation and reproducible research;
* excellent ability to communicate in English.


 Experience of local or open-source language models, RAG, fine-tuning, multilingual NLP or advanced quantitative methods is considered an advantage.
   

  

 Experience of research in political science, political psychology, media studies, computational social science, or another relevant social science field is considered an advantage.
   

  

 Great importance will be attached to the ability to communicate advanced methodological issues clearly and pedagogically, and to collaborate effectively with researchers with varying methodological backgrounds. Experience of supervision, training or methodological support is considered an advantage
   

  

 Knowledge of Swedish or another Scandinavian language is considered an advantage.
   

  

 Great importance will be attached to personal suitability. We are looking for a researcher who is independent, proactive and communicative and who has a strong ability to collaborate with researchers from different methodological backgrounds.
   

  

 Application
   

  

**The Application Must Include**
* a cover letter explaining why you are qualified for the position;
* a CV including a list of scientific publications or a project portfolio
* copies of official academic degree certificates.


 Applications must be submitted via the Swedish Defence University’s recruitment system by clicking on the ‘Apply’ link on the job advertisement page. The recruitment system contains a number of screening questions to be answered. Here you should enter your experience and qualifications and upload any supporting documents you wish to submit in support of your application.
   

  

 The complete application must be received by the Swedish Defence University no later than midnight on the closing date, CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time).
   

  

 Terms om Employment
   

  

 The position is a full-time fixed-term appointment for 12 months.
   

  

 Location: Stockholm.
   

  

 Employment at the Swedish Defence University may be subject to security screening in accordance with the Swedish Protective Security Act (2018:585).
   

  

 Starting date
   

  

 January 1, 2027, or by agreement.
   

  

 The Swedish Defence University applies individual salary setting
   

  

 You are welcome to submit your application until October 18th!

title: Cloud Engineer (All genders)
description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.
   

  

 We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
* The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
* You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
* We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.


**Your Mission**
 As a Cloud Engineer (All genders), you will focus on transforming service requests into production-ready, scalable environments. By utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC), you ensure every deployment is executed with precision, security, and thorough documentation.
   

  

 Your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of our embedded autonomy infrastructure deployed across air, land, and sea systems.
   

  

**What You Will Do At Stark**
* Act as the primary contact for infrastructure service requests.
* Build and maintain Terraform modules to ensure consistent state management and streamlined deployments.
* Configure and install services with a strong emphasis on security protocols.
* Monitor cloud provider activities to ensure cost-efficiency and compliance with security standards.
* Produce detailed "How-to" guides for new services to enable developer self-service.


**What You Bring To The Mission**
* 2 to 4 years of professional Cloud Engineering experience.
* Strong practical knowledge of GCP is preferred; AWS or Azure experts willing to transition are welcome. Experience with hybrid or on-prem systems is a plus.
* Advanced proficiency in Terraform.
* Skilled in Kubernetes (k8s / GKE) and GitOps frameworks like Flux or Kustomize.
* A commitment to supporting technical teams through well-architected infrastructure.


**Equal Opportunity**
 At Stark Defence, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team. We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.
   

  

 If you are excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications—ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. We value unique perspectives, adaptability, and a drive to solve high-stakes challenges.
   

  

**Security Clearance**
 Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

title: Data Analyst - NOCCO | Barebells | Vitamin Well
description:
***Vitamin Well Group***
*develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.*
 We are building a team to lead the next phase of Vitamin Well Group’s digital business, working across e-commerce, data and AI.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Data Analyst to join us in a new, global role. You will work from underlying data through to analysis – spanning data modelling, transformation and quality through to dashboards and insights – helping shape how we structure, connect and use data as our digital business grows. Working closely with our Analytics Lead and AI Lead, you will join while much of our data capability is still being built.
   

  

**About the role**
 This is a hands-on role that brings the technical and analytical sides of data together. You will work directly with data using SQL, build and transform datasets in a modern cloud data environment, and take that work through to analysis, visualisation and business decisions.
   

  

 Your work will connect you with Digital Sales, CRM, Performance Marketing, Social, Product and Engineering. One project could involve modelling customer and transaction data, another connecting a new marketing data source or improving how we measure retention or LTV. At other times, you might start with an open-ended business question and work your way from the underlying data to an analysis that leads to action.
   

  

**What you will work on**
* Build and maintain reliable, reusable data models and transformations.
* Turn open-ended business questions into structured analysis and actionable insights.
* Analyse customer behaviour and growth across areas such as acquisition, retention, attribution and customer lifetime value.
* Create dashboards and self-serve analytics that enable teams to understand and act on their KPIs.
* Work with different data sources, contributing to ingestion, integrations and data quality.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering on event instrumentation, schema design and data best practices.


**What you can expect**
* Plenty left to build. You are joining a growing data setup, with the opportunity to improve what exists and help shape what comes next.
* Problems that are not already solved. Multiple brands, markets and digital channels bring real complexity – and plenty for someone who likes figuring things out.
* High ownership from the start. You will be expected to bring your perspective, challenge existing approaches and drive your work forward, working closely with our Analytics Lead and AI Lead.
* A fast-growing international business. Your work sits behind the digital growth of Barebells, Vitamin Well and NOCCO, with the pace and change that comes with it.


**Who you are**
 You have hands-on experience working with data from source to insight. You have experience with data modelling and cloud data platforms, and know how to turn underlying data into analysis that supports business decisions.
   

  

 You move naturally between the technical and analytical sides of the work – understanding how data is structured and transformed while also investigating business questions, identifying what matters and communicating your findings clearly.
   

  

 You are curious, technically sharp and pragmatic. You enjoy getting into complex problems, finding your way forward when the answer is not obvious and taking ownership from question to solution.
   

  

**We believe you have:**
* Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working directly with data from databases.
* Experience with analytical data modelling and transformation tools such as dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar.
* Experience working with cloud data platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS, Snowflake or Databricks.
* Experience turning data into analysis, dashboards and visualisations that support business decisions.
* A good understanding of ELT/ETL workflows and how data moves between sources and systems.
* Working knowledge of Python.
* Professional proficiency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.


**Chances are, you have also worked with some of the following:**
* APIs, integrations or data pipelines.
* AI-native coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar.
* Sales and marketing data from platforms such as Shopify, GA4, Meta or Google Ads.
* AI/LLM products, event instrumentation or experimentation.


 How to apply
   

  

*Application deadline: October 30th 2026*
 We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline. We appreciate LinkedIn, but to get a full picture of your experience, we ask you to also include a CV.
   

  

**Life at Vitamin Well Group**
 At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. Our values – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – shape how we work together and how we do business.
   

  

 Across functions and markets, our teams are hands-on in building our brands, developing our products and making them available to consumers around the world. We embrace an office-first principle because we believe our best ideas emerge when people come together, share ideas, build relationships and take ownership.
   

  

 Promoting active lifestyles is part of our culture. Employees can take part in run clubs, group workouts, races and sporting events that suit different interests and fitness levels. As we continue to grow, we aim to make a positive impact by reducing our environmental footprint, promoting active and healthy lifestyles, and acting responsibly across our value chain.
   

  

*As part of the recruitment process, we may ask you to conduct a personality test as well as a test that measures logical ability. The purpose of the tests is to evaluate candidates as objective as possible and identify the best possible match for the role. The tests are based on solid research and are taken through our partner Alva Labs.*

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
*Har du erfarenhet av testautomatisering och vill vara en del av ett framstående bolag inom InsurTech? Då kan du vara den vi letar efter!*
**Vad du kommer att göra:**
 Som Test Automation Engineer kommer du att arbeta i ett agilt team med fokus på testautomatisering och kvalitetssäkring. Tillsammans planerar och utför ni lämpliga tester, både automatiserade och utforskande i Lumera Core, vårt marknadsledande standardsystem för liv- och pensionsbranschen.
   

  

 En viktig del av rollen är att skriva, vidareutveckla och underhålla automatiserade testfall i Java, samtidigt som du bidrar med idéer för att utveckla våra tester och verktyg. Du arbetar nära både våra utvecklingsteam och leveransteam för att säkerställa hög kvalitet.
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om hur det är att jobba inom test på Lumera? Läs intervjun med Satu här.
   

  

**Arbetet innefattar också:**
* Att vara med i vårt arbete inom AI och testautomatisering.
* Att skapa, underhålla och vidareutveckla automatiserade testfall i Java.
* Att analysera testresultat.
* Att hålla dig uppdaterad med de senaste trenderna inom testautomatisering


**Hos oss får du:**
* Engagerade kollegor som stöttar varandra och värdesätter teamwork.
* Omväxlande och roligt arbete med en komplex och samhällsviktig produkt.
* Karriär och utvecklingsmöjligheter där du får ta egna initiativ och axla eget ansvar.
* Centralt kontor med flexibiliteten att jobba hemifrån upp till två dagar i veckan.
* Fokus på välmående med ett förmånspaket som stödjer både fysisk och mental hälsa.


**Vem är du?**
* Nyfiken, analytisk och tycker om att lösa komplexa problem.
* Några års erfarenhet av testautomatisering, gärna i miljöer där testfall skrivs som kod.
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD-verktyg (Gitlab, Jenkins) och SOAP/REST-baserade tjänster.
* Du trivs med att skriva kod i Java och SQL.
* Du uttrycker dig väl på både svenska och engelska.


**Vi ser det även som meriterande att du har**
* ISTQB-certifiering.
* Kunskap om modern infrastruktur, till exempel containers, mikrotjänster och Azure DevOps.
* Erfarenhet av serverhantering


 Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan med CV eller LinkedIn-profil så snart som möjligt. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!
   

  

 Om du har ytterligare frågor, vänligen hör av dig till  johan.ostlund@lumera.com
   

  

 En bakgrundskontroll kommer genomföras i samband med anställning.
   

  

**Om Lumera**
 Lumera är ett insurtechbolag som driver digital transformation inom den globala liv- och pensionsbranschen. Vi erbjuder tekniklösningar för försäkringsadministration, datahantering och migrering till en bred bas med framstående kunder. Dessutom erbjuder vi ett brett utbud av experttjänster som kombinerar vår tekniska och branschspecifika kompetens, anpassade till varje lokal marknad och där ansvarsfull AI bidrar till ökad automatisering och förbättrad datakvalitet.
   

  

 Vårt uppdrag – the Prudent Revolution – handlar om att förena teknologi med partnerskap för att erbjuda liv- och pensionsbolag den snabbaste och tryggaste resan genom komplex förändring.
   

  

 Lumera har sitt huvudkontor i Stockholm, med ytterligare kontor i Storbritannien, Nederländerna, Norge, Sverige och Vietnam.
   

  

 Huvudägaren av Lumera är Monterro, ledande mjukvaruinvesterare i Norden.
   

  

 www.lumera.com
   

  

 Följ oss på LinkedIn.
   

  

 We are Lumera - pioneering the digital transformation of the Life and Pensions industry. With strategic partnerships and advanced automation, we streamline policy administration, making complex processes simpler. Our mission, The Prudent Revolution, guides L&P providers through change, ensuring a smooth transition. Trusted for migrations and armed with deep domain expertise and innovative AI solutions, Lumera shapes the future. Join us on this innovative journey!

title: Verksamhetsutvecklare inom föräldraförsäkringen till Norrköping
description:
Placeringsort Flera orterDiarienummer FK 2026/031455
   

  

 Logga in och sök jobbet Öppnas i nytt fönster
   

  

*Varje år fattar Försäkringskassan 21 miljoner beslut som påverkar människors liv och hela samhället. Vi betalar ut cirka 260 miljarder kronor varje år. Det är allas skattepengar vi har hand om. Det är ett stort ansvar. Därför sätter vi oss in i varje ärende, följer lagar och regler, informerar och vägleder, bryr oss och visar omtanke. Det är ett jobb för dig som vill vara med och ta ansvar. Välkommen till Försäkringskassan.*
 Verksamhetsutveckling, analys och intern samverkan
   

  

 Som verksamhetsutvecklare ansvarar du för att driva och stödja kundorienterad verksamhetsutveckling som bidrar till förverkligandet av Försäkringskassans vision och verksamhetsidé. Du har även ett ansvar att uppmärksamma utvecklingsbehov och omsätta dessa till konkreta aktiviteter.
   

  

 I tjänsten ingår att bevaka och vara väl insatt i aktuell samhällsutveckling av betydelse för Försäkringskassan samt att utifrån detta analysera tänkbara konsekvenser för verksamheten. I arbetet ingår också att medverka i olika nätverk och bland annat delta i beredningar, verksamhetsplanering och årsredovisningar. Tjänsten innebär att du hanterar sekretessbelagda uppgifter vilket ställer höga krav på rätt hantering. Därför är det viktigt att du som ska arbeta hos oss har högt säkerhetsmedvetande. Vår utvecklingsverksamhet drivs utifrån agila värderingar och arbetssätt. Att arbeta agilt hos oss innebär att vi arbetar i team, att vi utgår ifrån kund- och användarinsikter, samt att vi ständigt strävar efter att förbättra oss och våra arbetssätt.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som
   

  

* har högskoleexamen eller erfarenheter och kvalifikationer som kan prövas likvärdiga
* har flerårig erfarenhet från arbete inom verksamhetsutveckling
* har mycket goda kunskaper inom förändrings- och utvecklingsprocesser
* har goda erfarenheter av olika samarbetsformer
* agerar på eget initiativ och tar ansvar för att nå goda resultat
* har förmåga att skapa ett användbart nätverk
* kan förstå och analysera komplexa frågor
* kommer med innovativa idéer och lösningar som främjar utveckling
* samarbetar effektivt med andra för att nå gemensamma mål
* har god kommunikativ förmåga, i både tal och skrift.


 Det är meriterande om du
   

  

* har erfarenhet av agilt arbetssätt
* har erfarenhet av att arbeta i en stor offentlig organisation
* har arbetat med digitalisering
* har erfarenhet av processutveckling
* har erfarenhet av förmånerna inom föräldraförsäkringen
* tidigare ledarerfarenhet.


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

 Övrigt
   

  

 3 tjänster, tillsvidare, heltid, med tillträde 1 mars eller enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning kan bli aktuellt. Vissa anställningar hos oss innebär deltagande i säkerhetskänslig verksamhet. För att bli anställd i en sådan tjänst krävs godkänd säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585).
   

  

 I enlighet med Försäkringskassans riktlinje för säkerhet genomförs bakgrundskontroller i denna rekrytering. Möjlighet till distansarbete finns om arbetet tillåter. I den här rekryteringen kan arbetspsykologiska test användas som en del i urvalsarbetet. Placeringsorter: Stockholm, Göteborg, Jönköping, Lidköping, Karlshamn och Norrköping.
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om Försäkringskassan som arbetsgivare? Besök fk.se/jobbahososs
   

  

 Kontaktpersoner
   

  

 Chef: Fredrika Järnehall Box, 010-112 08 68 (för frågor om tjänsten). HR-specialist: Micaela Kallaris, micaela.kallaris@forsakringskassan.se, 010-113 44 89 (för frågor om rekryteringsprocessen). ST: Therese Plantin, 010-119 22 35, Jenny Karlsson, 010-113 40 58 Saco-S: Daria Memetovic, 010-118 40 78 Seko: Johanna Grundström, 010-115 30 44.
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 5:e november 2026. När du ansöker bifogar du ditt CV. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekryteringar, du får istället besvara ett antal urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Ladda upp dina examensbevis, betyg och intyg i samband med din ansökan.
   

  

 Har du skyddade personuppgifter eller ingen tillgång till bank-id ringer du den HR-specialist som finns namngiven i annonsen så får du hjälp med att skicka in din ansökan.
   

  

 Vi ska i allt vi gör, agera med utgångspunkt i principen om alla människors lika värde, rättssäkerhet och med god service.

title: Lösningsarkitekt PIM till Martin & Servera!
description:
*Vill du kombinera arkitektur med ett arbete nära både tekniken och verksamheten? Hos Martin & Servera får du en central roll i en omfattande digital transformation där masterdata, PIM och framtidens SAP-landskap är viktiga delar. Här får du vara med och forma hur affärskritisk artikel- och produktinformation ska struktureras, integreras och användas framåt.*
**Din vardag**
 Som Lösningsarkitekt PIM får du ett övergripande ansvar för lösningsarkitekturen kring artikel- och produktinformation. Du arbetar nära både verksamheten och IT och blir en viktig länk mellan affärsbehov, information och teknik.En central del av uppdraget är att säkerställa hur artikelinformation rör sig genom hela systemlandskapet, mellan PIM, ERP/SAP, e-handel och andra mottagande system. Du utformar och dokumenterar lösningsarkitektur, datamodeller och integrationsflöden samt säkerställer att lösningarna är robusta, framtidssäkra och följer relevanta standarder.
   

  

 Som Lösningsarkitekt PIM kommer du bland annat att arbeta med Informatica PIM360, SAP S/4HANA och MuleSoft. En viktig del av rollen är att förstå hur GS1-standarder omsätts i datamodeller, informationsstrukturer och integrationer, samt att utveckla arbetet med datakvalitet, validering och governance.
   

  

 Detta är en roll där du kombinerar strategiskt arkitekturarbete med ett nära samarbete med verksamhet och utvecklingsteam. Du deltar i workshops och utvecklingsinitiativ, visualiserar framtida lösningar och fungerar som tekniskt bollplank i viktiga vägval. Samtidigt är du med och påverkar arkitekturprinciper och tekniska standarder genom företagets arkitekturråd.
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 Vi Söker Dig Som Har Ett Tydligt Arkitekturperspektiv Och Förstår Hur Information Och Data Rör Sig Genom Komplexa Systemlandskap. Vi Tror Att Du Har
   

  

* Mycket god förståelse för systemutveckling, datamodellering, masterdatahantering och informationsstruktur, särskilt kopplat till artikel- eller produktinformation.
* Erfarenhet av PIM-system, exempelvis Informatica PIM360 eller motsvarande.
* God kunskap om GS1-standarder och förståelse för hur dessa påverkar datamodeller, system, integrationer och processer.
* Erfarenhet av att designa och dokumentera lösningsarkitektur, integrationer, datamodeller och informationsflöden i komplexa IT-landskap.
* Erfarenhet av ERP-system och integrationsplattformar. Kunskap inom SAP S/4HANA och MuleSoft är särskilt relevant.
* God förståelse för datakvalitet, validering, governance och informationssäkerhet.
* Förmåga att förstå verksamhetens behov och omsätta dem till hållbara och genomförbara tekniska lösningar.
* Förmåga att kommunicera och samarbeta med såväl utvecklare och arkitekter som verksamhetsnära intressenter.
* Mycket god svenska samt god engelska i tal och skrift.


 Som person är du analytisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs i samarbetet mellan verksamhet och IT, är pedagogisk i din kommunikation och har modet att utmana befintliga lösningar när du ser bättre vägar framåt. Du uppskattar eget ansvar och en miljö där initiativ och nya idéer uppmuntras.
   

  

**Om organisationen**
 Tillsammans gör vi på Martin & Servera skillnad för alla som älskar mat och dryck. Med omtanke om varandra, våra kunder och planeten driver vi varje dag restaurangbranschen framåt. Och som medarbetare hos oss är du en viktig del av helheten. Här tas dina erfarenheter, idéer och kunskaper tillvara.
   

  

**Stabilt och långsiktigt**
 Vi har en stark och långsiktig ägare i form av familjeägda Axel Johnson, vilket skapar både trygghet och stora utvecklingsmöjligheter inom koncernen.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder dig**
 Hos oss får du ett spännande jobb med goda förmåner som till exempel ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag, sjukvårdande bidrag och lunchsubvention. Vi utmanar oss själva och värdesätter prestationer på samma sätt som vi värnar om en bra balans mellan jobb och privatliv. Vi erbjuder möjlighet till distansarbete två dagar i veckan.
   

  

 För oss är det viktigt med en trygg och säker arbetsmiljö, därför utför vi slumpmässiga drog- och alkoholtester på våra arbetsplatser. Välkommen till oss!
   

  

**Kontakt**
 I denna rekrytering samarbetar Martin & Servera med Wise.
   

  

 Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail, utan du söker enkelt med ditt CV eller din LinkedIn-profil på wise.se. Vi använder kompetensbaserad rekrytering som metod. Det gör vi i vår strävan efter en mer potentialbaserad matchning. Vi ser därför gärna sökanden med olika bakgrunder, åldrar och erfarenheter, eftersom vi vet att en bredare mångfald berikar var och en av oss och gör oss bättre och smartare som organisation.
   

  

 Har du frågor om processen eller rollen? Kontakta då ansvarig rekryteringskonsult
 **Gustaf Linder,** 
**gustaf.linder@wise.se** 
 . Vi intervjuar löpande så rollen kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum. Innan ett beslut om anställning fattas kommer en bakgrundskontroll att genomföras.
   

  

**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!**

title: Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer | Saab
description:
**Välkommen till AI & Data!** 




  





***AI & Data är hjärtat i Saabs framtida intelligenta förmåga***
*. Som en central del av Common Tech ansvarar AI & Data för att bygga och vidareutveckla de gemensamma AI-, data- och analysplattformar som möjliggör nästa generations system, produkter och operativa förmågor.* 




*Här arbetar du med storskalig datahantering, avancerad analys och AI-lösningar som används i verksamhetskritiska miljöer. Fokus ligger på att omsätta data till faktisk förmåga - från robusta dataplattformar och AI-pipelines till maskininlärning, inferens och intelligenta beslutsstöd som får direkt genomslag i flera delar av organisationen.* 




  





*AI & Data är också navet för Saabs satsningar på framtidens AI-infrastruktur. Ett tydligt exempel är engagemanget i* 
***Sferical AI***
*, där Saab är med och bygger tillgång till världsledande AI-compute och avancerade AI-miljöer. Det skapar förutsättningar för utveckling av AI i stor skala och gör det möjligt att ligga i absolut framkant inom artificiell intelligens, även i miljöer med höga krav på säkerhet, tillgänglighet och prestanda.* 




  





*I AI & Data kombineras djup teknisk kompetens med ett långsiktigt och strategiskt perspektiv. Arbetet handlar inte om isolerade lösningar, utan om att bygga stabila, skalbara och framtidssäkra AI- och datakapabiliteter som andra team, produkter och affärsområden kan lita på och vidareutveckla.* 




*Vill du arbeta nära framtidens AI, storskalig datateknik och avancerad infrastruktur - och vara med och forma Saabs intelligenta system - är AI & Data rätt plats för dig..* 




  





**Roller till SAAB i Stockholm | Linköping | Göteborg**

Målet är att ge Saabs team rätt tekniska grund för att kunna utveckla avancerade produkter med hög kvalitet, säkerhet och tillförlitlighet.

title: Master Thesis: Machine Learning classification in Integrated Sensing and Communication
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 Modern radio networks can be used as radar-like sensors to detect and classify moving objects — a capability broadly referred to as Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC). Our team builds the machine-learning models behind this capability.
   

  

 As we deploy the models to different locations and extend it to more object classes, two operational problems dominate our research agenda:
   

  

* Cross-location generalisation: models trained on data from one location do not always transfer to another. Every new location currently requires labelled data-to attune for the new location — a slow and expensive step that gates deployment.
* Multi-class extension: adding new object classes without degrading performance on existing ones. It involves architectural trade-offs that are not obvious.


 We are offering three related master's thesis opportunities on these problems, all rooted in production machine learning. Please indicate in your application which direction you are most interested in. The exact scope of each project will be refined together with the student based on their interests, background, and the state of our data and models when the project starts.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Direction 1: Cross-location Generalisation of a spectral image Classifier


 Benchmark modern domain-generalisation methods for image data. Implement source-free adaptation methods that adjust the model at deployment using only unlabelled data from the new site.
   

  

* Direction 2: Cross-location Generalisation of a time-series Classifier


 Benchmark modern domain-generalisation methods for time-series data. Implement source-free adaptation methods that adjust the model at deployment using only unlabelled data from the new site.
   

  

* Direction 3: Modular Classifier Design for Multi-Class Object Classification


 Benchmark methods for multi-class classification models such as Hierarchical tree, Mixture-of-experts and flat softmax. Evaluate how well they perform when adding additional classes and seeing new locations.
   

  

**The skills you bring:**
* You are pursuing a master's degree in computer science, machine learning, applied mathematics, or a related field.
* Good understanding of modern machine learning, particularly deep learning.
* Strong programming skills, familiarity with deep learning frameworks, and an interest in experimental, research-oriented work.
* You are analytical, curious, and able to work independently while communicating your results clearly.


**Why join Ericsson?** 
 At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
   

  

**What happens once you apply?** 
 Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

 Sweden (SE) || Stockholm

title: Postdoctoral researcher in War Studies with a focus on Russian military capability and warfare
description:
The Swedish Defence University in Stockholm is currently recruiting up to two Postdoctoral Researchers to the Strategy Division within the Department of War Studies.
   

  

 Project description
   

  

 The postdoctoral researcher will participate in a research project on Russian warfare comprising of three pillars: Russian military capability (economy, industrial production, organization, command, personnel, materiel, and readiness); Russian military theory, strategy, and doctrine (conceptual aspects of Russian warfare); and lessons learned from the war in Ukraine.
   

  

 The postdoctoral researcher will conduct research on their own specific topic within the project while also contributing to the broader research area at the Swedish Defence University.
   

  

 Duties
   

  

 The post-doctoral researcher is expected to contribute to the Russia studies project by planning and conducting appropriate research in contact with the project leader. The work will take the form of scientific publications in well-established journals or presses. The work should be conducted in close cooperation with other researchers in the project and in international networks.
   

  

 Research is 80% of the employment and there is an opportunity to work with teaching andsupervision up to 20%.
   

  

 General Requirements
   

  

 To be eligible for the position of postdoctoral researcher, the candidate must hold a doctoral degree—or a foreign degree deemed equivalent to a doctoral degree—in a subject relevant to the research assignment, no later than the start date of the position. While a degree in a social science subject is preferred, other applicants are also welcome, provided they have a relevant research profile.
   

  

 Priority is given to candidates who completed their doctoral degree no more than 3 years before the application deadline. The application deadline serves as the reference point for calculating this three-year period. Exceptions may be made for special circumstances, such as leave due to illness, parental leave, or positions of trust in trade unions.
   

  

 Applicants must not have previously been employed as a postdoctoral researcher for more than one year within the same or a related subject area at the same employer.
   

  

 Great importance is placed on personal suitability. To thrive and succeed in the role, you should be motivated, organized, and communicative, with a strong ability to take initiative and start new tasks. We expect you to actively participate in the department’s research activities and enjoy collaborating with others.
   

  

 Additional assessment criteria
   

  

* Documented scholarly expertise in Russian military capabilities and warfare
* Documented experience in independent and collaborative research
* Excellent communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English
* Proficiency in Russian
* Proficiency in Swedish or a Scandinavian language
* Relevant military experience


**About The Employment**
 This is a fixed-term, full-time position for two years under the central collective agreement, with the possibility of a one-year extension.
   

  

 Employment at the Swedish Defence University may involve a security clearance in accordance with the Security Protection Act (2018:585).
   

  

 The position may also involve wartime deployment. If you are already assigned to wartime duties in your current role at a government agency and your skills are required within the Swedish Defence University’s wartime organisation, negotiations will take place between the relevant agency and the Swedish Defence University regarding your placement.
   

  

 Start date
   

  

 As soon as possible or by agreement.
   

  

 Salary and benefits
   

  

 The Swedish Defence University applies individual salary setting.
   

  

 Employee benefits at the Swedish Defence University - FHS/Benefits/employee.
   

  

 Application
   

  

**Application Shall Contain**
* a project plan where you present (maximum three pages) the research that you would want to work on within this employment.
* CV should include academic publications
* a copy of the PhD certificate.


 If you have not defended your PhD, please provide expected viva date.

title: Usability Engineering Lead
description:
**Mission** 




 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
 



  





 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We're looking for an experienced Usability Engineer / Human Factors Engineer to drive usability engineering activities across Neko Health's product development, and to lead the development of this domain within the Verification & Validation team.
 



 You'll bring hands-on experience applying IEC 62366-1 to medical device product development, alongside proven experience implementing usability practices that meet FDA human factors guidance. You'll work closely with the Usability & Validation Engineers on the team to get design feedback into projects as early as possible, so that Neko's medical devices are safe to use.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Usability engineering in product development: join product development projects as part of the usability engineering practice, leading usability engineering activities on each project from early concept through final verification
* Domain leadership: grow the domain's capability and practice until it becomes a reference for best practice in a fast-moving environment, constantly questioning processes without losing sight of purpose and user impact
* Process and practice: continuously improve how usability engineering integrates with product development, enabling it to run alongside development. Build instructions, tooling, and training to efficiently support multiple development projects
* Design feedback, early: collaborate with Product, Design, Clinical, Engineering ,and other disciplines to integrate design feedback in projects as early as possible, ensuring safety in use is designed in rather than tested later
* Formative and summative evaluation: plan, run, and document usability evaluations following IEC 62366-1 and FDA human factors guidance, leveraging Neko's vertical integration for direct, in-house access to clinical personnel
* Design validation: oversee validation of UI-related user requirements and verification of use-related risk controls, ensuring both processes are efficient enough to keep up with development without becoming bottlenecks



  





**Must-have** 




 About you
 


* 6+ years of experience in usability engineering or human factors for regulated medical devices
* Hands-on expertise with IEC 62366-1 usability engineering, including planning and conducting formative and summative evaluations on medical devices and performing use-related risk analysis
* FDA human factors experience, implementing usability engineering practices that meet FDA guidance with concrete examples
* Experience with regulated medical devices, understanding how usability and design validation evidence fit into a technical file or design history file under ISO 13485 and EU MDR
* Built or scaled a usability engineering practice by developing methods, tooling, or teams, beyond just executing individual studies
* Comfortable working with both hardware and software; experience with medical devices that include hardware-software combinations as well as software-only devices (SaMD), ensuring cohesive usability engineering across both



  





**Nice to have** 



* Experience in an early-stage or fast-growing company, where process, team structure and priorities shift as the company scales
* Experience standing up a new practice or domain
* ISO 14971 risk management experience, specifically where use error and product risk intersect



  





**Why this role matters** 




 Usability engineering is core to how we build safe medical devices: it's the discipline that lets us say, with confidence, that our products aren't just functional, but safe and easy to use. At Neko we want to keep challenging how we do things so we can move faster, but never at the cost of safety or quality. As our product portfolio grows, we need a usability engineering practice that grows with it, one that keeps pace rather than becoming the bottleneck.
 



  





 This role is driving how usability engineering at Neko becomes a reference on integration of best practices into a fast-pacing and always innovating environment.

title: Enterprise Architect – Data & Information Modeling
description:
**About Justera Group**
 Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. The company has deep expertise in IT consultancy, software development, and recruitment services, providing clients with purpose-driven, well-trained consultants who consistently deliver efficient and effective results. Justera Group manages the entire talent lifecycle, from hiring to ongoing management, ensuring the right fit for each project on time and within budget. With their strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and client success, Justera Group is a trusted partner for technology innovation across Sweden.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 We are seeking a highly experienced Enterprise Architect specializing in Data & Information Modeling to support a strategic data transformation initiative within a leading organization in the construction and engineering sector.
   

  

 The organization is accelerating its journey toward becoming a truly data-driven business by making critical business data accessible through its analytics and AI platform. The initiative aims to strengthen data accessibility, improve decision-making, and enable advanced analytics and AI-driven business capabilities across the organization.
   

  

 As an Enterprise Architect, you will play a key role in shaping the organization's information architecture, developing robust information models, and ensuring that business requirements are translated into a consistent and well-governed data foundation.
   

  

 This role requires a strong combination of enterprise architecture expertise, information modeling capabilities, and the ability to collaborate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Analyze business and analytical data requirements and translate them into structured information models.
* Define, develop, and maintain conceptual and logical information models across multiple business domains.
* Identify information gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement across existing systems, data sources, and business processes.
* Establish alignment between information models, enterprise architecture principles, business terminology, and governance standards.
* Support the integration and harmonization of data from multiple domains to enable advanced analytics and AI use cases.
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Business Analytics, Data Management, Integration, Solution Architecture, and other relevant functions.
* Facilitate workshops and discussions to establish common business concepts, information domains, and data requirements.
* Contribute to enterprise-wide architecture initiatives and cross-functional data transformation programs.
* Support information governance, prioritization, ownership, metadata management, and data quality practices.
* Ensure that information architecture supports strategic business objectives and the organization's long-term data ambitions.


**Requirements:**
**Information Architecture – Level 4**
* Ability to define and maintain enterprise-wide information structures, domains, business concepts, and relationships between information assets.
* Experience establishing consistent information architecture across multiple business areas.


**Information Modeling – Level 4**
* Extensive experience designing and maintaining conceptual and logical information models.
* Proven ability to harmonize information structures across domains and translate business requirements into clear, structured models.


**Enterprise Architecture – Level 4**
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles and the ability to align information architecture with business strategy and the wider architectural landscape.
* Experience contributing to enterprise-level architecture decisions and transformation initiatives.


**Data Governance & Information Management – Level 4**
* Experience applying data governance principles, information ownership, metadata management, data quality practices, and information standards.
* Ability to promote consistency, transparency, and accountability in enterprise information management.


**Data Architecture – Level 3**
* Understanding of data structures, source systems, integrations, and data flows.
* Knowledge of the architectural requirements of analytics and AI platforms.


**Business Analysis & Requirements Management – Level 3**
* Ability to understand business needs, identify information gaps, and translate requirements into architecture and modeling deliverables.
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills.


**Required Experience and Qualifications**
* Several years of experience as an Enterprise Architect, Information Architect, or in a similar senior architecture role within a large and complex organization.
* Strong expertise in information architecture and information modeling.
* Experience supporting data-driven transformation initiatives, enterprise data programs, or similar strategic projects.
* Practical experience using ArchiMate for information architecture and modeling.
* Proven ability to work across business and technical teams and communicate complex architectural concepts clearly.
* Experience facilitating workshops and aligning stakeholders around business terminology, information domains, and data requirements.
* Full professional proficiency in both Swedish and English.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience using Sparx Enterprise Architect.
* Background in data platforms, analytics environments, and AI-enabled organizations.
* Experience in construction, infrastructure, engineering, or other asset-intensive industries.
* Familiarity with enterprise data governance frameworks and information management best practices.


**What We Offer:**
* A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies
* The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
* A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development
* Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance
* 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax
* An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing
